Mctt.Core.Completeness.FunctionCases

Fundamental Theorem: Π-Types and Universal Propositions

Substitution pushes through Π, λ and application by computation of exp_sub: (a_pi r A B)[σ] is a_pi r (A[σ]) (B[q σ]). So only the congruence, β and η rules are validated here.
A Π carries a relevance tag. At relevant it is a type of functions in a universe: its domain is a type of that universe, a proposition (a function of a proof) or a type of levels, and its codomain is a type of the universe. At propositional it is the impredicative ∀: its domain is a type of any sort and its codomain a family of propositions, and it is itself a proposition.
The relevant case is organised around rel_typ_of_pi: the type judgment of a Π, at the canonical element PER per_pi. The rules whose type is a Π read their four values off it; application and β, whose type is the instantiated codomain, read it off rel_typ_of_instance at a relevant domain and off rel_typ_of_instance_prop at a propositional one, whose argument is kept as a proof ⋆ᵈ⟨N, ρ⟩.
Extensions carry the type of their head. A closure extends by the value of its own domain, per_pi by those of its type's, an instance by centry_tag; per_head_codomain_resp moves a codomain's head PER between any two of these.
The propositional case is proof irrelevance: the ∀ is a proposition (rel_exp_under_ctx_all), so every term of it, and every application of one, is a proof, related to every other (rel_exp_under_ctx_proof).
Cumulativity is needed for the level: per_univ_elem_pi_chain requires the domain and codomain of a Π-value to be related at one index, while the syntax types A and B at unrelated ones. So the domain's judgment is lifted to the codomain's index (rel_type_of_sort_ge).

Domains of Either Sort

A type of either sort is a type of every index from some index on: a type of a universe by cumulativity, a proposition at every index.
Lemma rel_type_of_sort_ge : forall {Γ A A' Srt},
    type_sort Srt ->
    Γ ⊨ A ≈ A' : Srt ->
    exists i, forall j, i <= j -> Γ ⊨ᵗ A ≈ A' at j.
Proof.
  intros * [i | |] H.
  - exists i; intros j Hj; exact (rel_type_of_typ (rel_exp_cumu_ge Hj H)).
  - exists 0; intros j _; exact (rel_type_of_prop j H).
  - exists 0; intros j _; exact (rel_type_of_level_sort j H).
Qed.

Related arguments read back at each of the four values of a chain of types: the entry types of the four extensions of a Π-pattern.
Lemma args_readable_of_chain : forall {i R a1 a2 a3 a4 c c'},
    rel_chain (per_univ_elem i R) ([a1; a2; a3; a4]) -> Dom c ≈ c' ∈ R ->
    args_readable_at c c' ([entry_type_value a1; entry_type_value a2; entry_type_value a3; entry_type_value a4]).
Proof.
  intros * Hc Hcc.
  assert (H11 : DF a1 ≈ a1 ∈ per_univ_elem i ↘ R) by pairwise.
  assert (H22 : DF a2 ≈ a2 ∈ per_univ_elem i ↘ R) by pairwise.
  assert (H33 : DF a3 ≈ a3 ∈ per_univ_elem i ↘ R) by pairwise.
  assert (H44 : DF a4 ≈ a4 ∈ per_univ_elem i ↘ R) by pairwise.
  assert (PER R) by (eapply per_elem_PER; exact H11).
  assert (Hc1 : Dom c ≈ c ∈ R) by (etransitivity; [ exact Hcc | symmetry; exact Hcc ]).
  assert (Hc2 : Dom c' ≈ c' ∈ R) by (etransitivity; [ symmetry; exact Hcc | exact Hcc ]).
  repeat constructor;
    first [ exact (proj1 (entry_readable_of_elem H11 Hc1)) | exact (proj1 (entry_readable_of_elem H11 Hc2))
          | exact (proj1 (entry_readable_of_elem H22 Hc1)) | exact (proj1 (entry_readable_of_elem H22 Hc2))
          | exact (proj1 (entry_readable_of_elem H33 Hc1)) | exact (proj1 (entry_readable_of_elem H33 Hc2))
          | exact (proj1 (entry_readable_of_elem H44 Hc1)) | exact (proj1 (entry_readable_of_elem H44 Hc2)) ].
Qed.

The head PER of a codomain at two extensions of a related pair of tails, by arguments related at the domain, is the one at any other such pair. The tags of the four extensions need only be readable: for example, the closures of a λ extend by the values of their own domains, a per_pi by those of its type's, an instance by centry_tag.
Lemma per_head_codomain_resp : forall {Γ κ A B} {i k : nat} {env_relΓ},
    EF Γ ≈ Γ ∈ per_ctx_env ↘ env_relΓ ->
    Γ ⊨ᵗ A ≈ A at i ->
    Γ ▹{κ} A ⊨ᵗ B ≈ B at k ->
    forall ρ ρ' a a' j R x y u v t t' s s',
      Dom ρ ≈ ρ' ∈ env_relΓ ->
      ⟦ A ⟧ ρ ↘ a -> ⟦ A ⟧ ρ' ↘ a' -> DF a ≈ a' ∈ per_univ_elem j ↘ R ->
      Dom x ≈ y ∈ R -> Dom u ≈ v ∈ R -> Dom u ≈ y ∈ R ->
      entry_readable (de_term x t) -> entry_readable (de_term y t') ->
      entry_readable (de_term u s) -> entry_readable (de_term v s') ->
      per_head B B (ρ ↦ x ⦂ t) (ρ' ↦ y ⦂ t') <~> per_head B B (ρ ↦ u ⦂ s) (ρ' ↦ v ⦂ s').
Proof.
  intros * HΓ HA HB * Hρ Ha Ha' HR Hxy Huv Huy Rx Ry Ru Rv.
  pose proof (per_ctx_env_of_typ (κ := κ) HΓ HA) as HΓA.
  assert (PER (per_env_extend A A env_relΓ)) by (eapply per_env_PER; exact HΓA).
  assert (H1 : Dom ρ ↦ x ⦂ t ≈ ρ' ↦ y ⦂ t' ∈ per_env_extend A A env_relΓ)
    by (apply per_env_extend_intro'; [ exact Hρ | eapply per_head_of; eassumption | exact Rx | exact Ry ]).
  assert (H2 : Dom ρ ↦ u ⦂ s ≈ ρ' ↦ y ⦂ t' ∈ per_env_extend A A env_relΓ)
    by (apply per_env_extend_intro'; [ exact Hρ | eapply per_head_of; eassumption | exact Ru | exact Ry ]).
  assert (H3 : Dom ρ ↦ u ⦂ s ≈ ρ' ↦ v ⦂ s' ∈ per_env_extend A A env_relΓ)
    by (apply per_env_extend_intro'; [ exact Hρ | eapply per_head_of; eassumption | exact Ru | exact Rv ]).
  eapply (per_head_of_type_resp HΓA HB).
  apply rel_chain_4; [ exact H1 | symmetry; exact H2 | exact H3 ].
Qed.

The codomain of a Π along a lifted substitution is of the relevant kind, at the left environment: its four values are types of a universe.
Lemma rel_typ_sort_of_univ_under_ctx_q : forall {Γ Δ σ σ' κ A} {i : nat} {B B' u env_relΓ},
    EF Γ ≈ Γ ∈ per_ctx_env ↘ env_relΓ ->
    Γ ⊨ˢ σ ≈ σ' : Δ ->
    Δ ⊨ᵗ A ≈ A at i ->
    Δ ▹{κ} A ⊨ B ≈ B' : universe_index_term u ->
    forall ρ ρ' ρσ ρ'σ' c c' t1 t2 t3 t4,
      Dom ρ ↦ c ⦂ t1 ≈ ρ' ↦ c' ⦂ t4 ∈ per_env_extend A[σ] A[σ] env_relΓ ->
      args_readable_at c c' ([t1; t2; t3; t4]) ->
      ⟦ σ : Δ ⟧s ρ ↘ ρσ ->
      ⟦ σ' : Δ ⟧s ρ' ↘ ρ'σ' ->
      rel_typ_kind B[q σ] (ρ ↦ c ⦂ t1) ak_relevant.
Proof.
  intros * HΓ Hσj HA HB * Hpair Hts Hev Hev'.
  pose proof (per_ctx_env_of_typ_sub (κ := κ) HΓ Hσj HA) as HΓA.
  pose proof (rel_sub_under_ctx_q (κ := κ) Hσj HA) as Hqj.
  pose proof (rel_exp_of_univ_inversion HB) as [env_relΔA [HΔA HBgen]].
  destruct (rel_sub_under_ctx_q_at HΓ HΔA Hσj HA _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hpair Hts Hev Hev')
    as [s [s' [Hq [Hq' _]]]].
  destruct (HBgen _ _ HΓA _ _ Hqj _ _ _ _ Hpair Hq Hq')
    as [b1 b2 b3 b4 Hb1 Hb2 Hb3 Hb4 [[_ Hr _] _]].
  exists b1; split; assumption.
Qed.

A type of a sort in an extended context, along the lifting q σ, is not LevelSort: its value is related to its value at the lifted environment, which is not (rel_type_under_ctx_not_level_sort).
Lemma rel_type_not_level_sort_under_ctx_q : forall {Γ Δ σ σ' κ A} {i j : nat} {B B' env_relΓ},
    EF Γ ≈ Γ ∈ per_ctx_env ↘ env_relΓ ->
    Γ ⊨ˢ σ ≈ σ' : Δ ->
    Δ ⊨ᵗ A ≈ A at i ->
    Δ ▹{κ} A ⊨ᵗ B ≈ B' at j ->
    forall ρ ρ' ρσ ρ'σ' c c' t1 t2 t3 t4,
      Dom ρ ↦ c ⦂ t1 ≈ ρ' ↦ c' ⦂ t4 ∈ per_env_extend A[σ] A[σ] env_relΓ ->
      args_readable_at c c' ([t1; t2; t3; t4]) ->
      ⟦ σ : Δ ⟧s ρ ↘ ρσ ->
      ⟦ σ' : Δ ⟧s ρ' ↘ ρ'σ' ->
      value_not_level_sort B[q σ] (ρ ↦ c ⦂ t1).
Proof.
  intros * HΓ Hσj HA HB * Hpair Hts Hev Hev'.
  pose proof (per_ctx_env_of_typ_sub (κ := κ) HΓ Hσj HA) as HΓA.
  pose proof (rel_sub_under_ctx_q (κ := κ) Hσj HA) as Hqj.
  pose proof (rel_type_under_ctx_not_level_sort _ _ _ _ HB) as HBn.
  pose proof (rel_type_inversion HB) as [env_relΔA [HΔA HBgen]].
  destruct (rel_sub_under_ctx_q_at HΓ HΔA Hσj HA _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hpair Hts Hev Hev')
    as [s [s' [Hq [Hq' Hchain]]]].
  destruct (HBgen _ _ HΓA _ _ Hqj _ _ _ _ Hpair Hq Hq')
    as [b1 b2 b3 b4 Hb1 Hb2 Hb3 Hb4 ([R12 H12] & _)].
  assert (P0 : Dom s ↦ c ⦂ centry_tag (ce_ass κ A) Δ s ≈ s ↦ c ⦂ centry_tag (ce_ass κ A) Δ s ∈ env_relΔA) by pairwise.
  destruct (HBn _ HΔA _ _ P0) as (w & Ew & Hnw).
  assert (w = b2) as -> by (eapply functional_eval_exp; eassumption).
  exists b1; split; [ exact Hb1 | exact (proj2 (per_univ_elem_not_level_sort_iff _ _ _ _ H12) Hnw) ].
Qed.

The values of a domain at the environments of a stage of a semantic judgment are not LevelSort: at the inner environment, and so along the chain.
Lemma domain_not_level_sort_at_stage : forall {Γ A A'} {i : nat} {k : universe_index} {Γ' env_rel' σ σ' ρ ρ' ρσ ρ'σ' in_rel a1 a2 a3 a4},
    Γ ⊨ᵗ A ≈ A' at i ->
    EF Γ' ≈ Γ' ∈ per_ctx_env ↘ env_rel' ->
    Γ' ⊨ˢ σ ≈ σ' : Γ -> Dom ρ ≈ ρ' ∈ env_rel' -> ⟦ σ : Γ ⟧s ρ ↘ ρσ -> ⟦ σ' : Γ ⟧s ρ' ↘ ρ'σ' ->
    ⟦ A ⟧ ρσ ↘ a2 -> rel_chain (per_univ_elem k in_rel) ([a1; a2; a3; a4]) ->
    not_level_sort a1.
Proof.
  intros * HA HΓ' Hσj Hρ Hev Hev' Ha2 Hachain.
  pose proof (rel_type_inversion HA) as [env_relΓ [HΓ _]].
  assert (Hρσ : Dom ρσ ≈ ρ'σ' ∈ env_relΓ) by (eapply rel_sub_under_ctx_at'; eassumption).
  destruct (rel_type_under_ctx_not_level_sort _ _ _ _ HA _ HΓ _ _ Hρσ) as (a0 & Ea0 & Hn0).
  assert (a0 = a2) as -> by (eapply functional_eval_exp; eassumption).
  assert (H12 : DF a1 ≈ a2 ∈ per_univ_elem k ↘ in_rel) by pairwise.
  exact (proj2 (per_univ_elem_not_level_sort_iff _ _ _ _ H12) Hn0).
Qed.

The Type Judgment of a Π

A stage of a semantic judgment, that is, a related pair of environments and a related pair of substitutions out of it, determines four Π-values and the canonical element PER they carry. Both are forced: (Π A B)[σ] is Π (A[σ]) (B[q σ]) definitionally, so eval_exp_pi applies to the substituted head directly, and the per_pi is the one per_univ_elem_pi_chain produces.
The domain is of either sort, at the codomain's index, and its four values are reported with both pairs a caller may need: the outer pair, at which per_env_extend_sub_intro and every irrelevance step along q σ are stated, and the inner pair, at which per_pi_iff must be applied, since the middle link of the type chain is Π a2 ρσ B ≈ Π a3 ρ'σ' B'.
Lemma rel_typ_of_pi : forall {Γ κd A A'} {i : nat} {B B'},
    Γ ⊨ᵗ A ≈ A at i ->
    Γ ⊨ᵗ A ≈ A' at i ->
    rel_type_kind Γ A κd ->
    Γ ▹{κd} A ⊨ B ≈ B' : Typeω@i ->
    forall Γ' env_rel',
      EF Γ' ≈ Γ' ∈ per_ctx_env ↘ env_rel' ->
      forall σ σ' ρ ρ' ρσ ρ'σ',
        Γ' ⊨ˢ σ ≈ σ' : Γ ->
        Dom ρ ≈ ρ' ∈ env_rel' ->
        ⟦ σ : Γ ⟧s ρ ↘ ρσ ->
        ⟦ σ' : Γ ⟧s ρ' ↘ ρ'σ' ->
        exists in_rel a1 a2 a3 a4,
          ⟦ A[σ] ⟧ ρ ↘ a1 /\
          ⟦ A ⟧ ρσ ↘ a2 /\
          ⟦ A' ⟧ ρ'σ' ↘ a3 /\
          ⟦ A'[σ'] ⟧ ρ' ↘ a4 /\
          DF a1 ≈ a4 ∈ per_univ_elem i ↘ in_rel /\
          DF a2 ≈ a3 ∈ per_univ_elem i ↘ in_rel /\
          Definitions.rel_typ i (Π{κd} A B) σ ρ ρσ (Π{κd} A' B') σ' ρ' ρ'σ'
            (per_pi a2 a3 in_rel B ρσ B' ρ'σ').
Proof.
  intros * HAself HA HAk HB * HΓ' * Hσj Hρ Hev Hev'.
  pose proof (rel_type_inversion HA) as [env_relΓ [HΓ HAgen]].
  destruct (HAgen _ _ HΓ' _ _ Hσj _ _ _ _ Hρ Hev Hev')
    as [a1 a2 a3 a4 Ha1 Ha2 Ha3 Ha4 Hachain].
The domain PER, named by weak functionality: the outer pair the caller is owed and the inner pair it needs are links of the same chain, with no refinement step in between.
  functionalize_per_univ_chain Hachain in_rel.
The domain's values are of the kind κd: at the inner environment, and so along the chain.
  assert (Hd1 : domain_kind a1 = κd).
  { assert (Hρσ : Dom ρσ ≈ ρ'σ' ∈ env_relΓ) by (eapply rel_sub_under_ctx_at'; eassumption).
    destruct (HAk _ HΓ _ _ Hρσ) as (a0 & Ea0 & <-).
    assert (a0 = a2) as -> by (eapply functional_eval_exp; eassumption).
    assert (H12 : DF a1 ≈ a2 ∈ per_univ_elem i ↘ in_rel) by pairwise.
    exact (per_univ_elem_kind _ _ _ _ H12). }
  exists in_rel, a1, a2, a3, a4.
  do 4 (split; [ eassumption |]).
  do 2 (split; [ pairwise |]).
  apply (mk_rel_exp Πᵈ{κd} a1 ρ B[q σ] Πᵈ{κd} a2 ρσ B
                    Πᵈ{κd} a3 ρ'σ' B' Πᵈ{κd} a4 ρ' B'[q σ']);
    [ apply eval_exp_pi; exact Ha1 | apply eval_exp_pi; exact Ha2
    | apply eval_exp_pi; exact Ha3 | apply eval_exp_pi; exact Ha4 |].
The three codomain obligations are, in order, the three q-obligations of B at an argument pair drawn from the domain PER, and the codomain is of the relevant kind.
  eapply per_univ_elem_pi_chain;
    [ exact Hachain | | | | | exact Hd1 | constructor | constructor
    | exact (domain_not_level_sort_at_stage HA HΓ' Hσj Hρ Hev Hev' Ha2 Hachain) | ];
    intros c c' Hc;
    pose proof (args_readable_of_chain Hachain Hc) as Hts;
    inversion Hts as [| ? ? [Hr1 Hr1'] Hts2]; subst; inversion Hts2 as [| ? ? [Hr2 Hr2'] Hts3]; subst;
      inversion Hts3 as [| ? ? [Hr3 Hr3'] Hts4]; subst; inversion Hts4 as [| ? ? [Hr4 Hr4'] _]; subst;
    pose proof (per_env_extend_sub_intro HΓ' Hσj HAself _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hρ Ha1
                  ltac:(pairwise) Hc Hr1 Hr4') as Hpair;
    [ destruct (rel_exp_of_typ_under_ctx_q HΓ' Hσj HAself HB _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hpair Hts Hev Hev')
        as [O1 [O2 O3]]; eassumption .. | |].
  - exact (rel_typ_sort_of_univ_under_ctx_q (u := ul i) HΓ' Hσj HAself HB _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hpair Hts Hev Hev').
  - exact (rel_type_not_level_sort_under_ctx_q HΓ' Hσj HAself (rel_type_of_typ HB) _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hpair Hts Hev Hev').
Qed.

A chain of Π-values into types of a universe in per_univ i is one of types of the relevant kind of the universe at i: a Π's kind is its codomain's.
Lemma rel_chain_pi_relevant : forall {i R κ a1 a2 a3 a4 ρ1 ρ2 ρ3 ρ4 B1 B2 B3 B4},
    rel_chain (per_univ_elem i R) ([Πᵈ{κ} a1 ρ1 B1; Πᵈ{κ} a2 ρ2 B2; Πᵈ{κ} a3 ρ3 B3; Πᵈ{κ} a4 ρ4 B4]) ->
    rel_chain (per_universe_elements (per_univ i)) ([Πᵈ{κ} a1 ρ1 B1; Πᵈ{κ} a2 ρ2 B2; Πᵈ{κ} a3 ρ3 B3; Πᵈ{κ} a4 ρ4 B4]).
Proof.
  intros * (H12 & H23 & H34).
  apply rel_chain_4; (constructor; [ eexists; eassumption | reflexivity | reflexivity | discriminate | discriminate ]).
Qed.

Π-Congruence in a Large Universe


Lemma rel_exp_under_ctx_pi_cong : forall {Γ κd A A'} {i : nat} {B B'},
    Γ ⊨ᵗ A ≈ A at i ->
    Γ ⊨ᵗ A ≈ A' at i ->
    rel_type_kind Γ A κd ->
    Γ ▹{κd} A ⊨ B ≈ B' : Typeω@i ->
    Γ ⊨ Π{κd} A B ≈ Π{κd} A' B' : Typeω@i.
Proof.
  intros * HAself HA HAk HB.
  pose proof (rel_type_inversion HA) as [env_relΓ [HΓ _]].
  eexists_rel_exp_of_typ.
  intros Γ' env_rel' HΓ' σ σ' Hσj ρ ρ' ρσ ρ'σ' Hρ Hev Hev'.
  destruct (rel_typ_of_pi HAself HA HAk HB _ _ HΓ' _ _ _ _ _ _ Hσj Hρ Hev Hev')
    as [in_rel [a1 [a2 [a3 [a4 [Ha1 [Ha2 [Ha3 [Ha4 [Houter [Hmid Htyp]]]]]]]]]]].
  destruct Htyp as [d1 d2 d3 d4 Hd1 Hd2 Hd3 Hd4 Hdchain].
  inversion Hd1; inversion Hd2; inversion Hd3; inversion Hd4; subst.
  functional_eval_rewrite_clear.
  apply (mk_rel_exp _ _ _ _ Hd1 Hd2 Hd3 Hd4).
  exact (rel_chain_pi_relevant Hdchain).
Qed.

Hint Resolve rel_exp_under_ctx_pi_cong : mctt.

Π into a Codomain of an Evaluated Kind

A type of the kind r (a type of a universe or a type of levels), along the lifting q σ of a semantic substitution: the three links of its chain, as rel_exp_of_univ_under_ctx_q gives for a type of a universe, and its kind at the extended environment.
Lemma rel_type_under_ctx_q : forall {Γ Δ σ σ' κ A r} {i j : nat} {B env_relΓ},
    EF Γ ≈ Γ ∈ per_ctx_env ↘ env_relΓ ->
    Γ ⊨ˢ σ ≈ σ' : Δ ->
    Δ ⊨ᵗ A ≈ A at i ->
    Δ ▹{κ} A ⊨ᵗ B ≈ B at j ->
    rel_type_kind (Δ ▹{κ} A) B r ->
    forall ρ ρ' ρσ ρ'σ' c c' t1 t2 t3 t4,
      Dom ρ ↦ c ⦂ t1 ≈ ρ' ↦ c' ⦂ t4 ∈ per_env_extend A[σ] A[σ] env_relΓ ->
      args_readable_at c c' ([t1; t2; t3; t4]) ->
      ⟦ σ : Δ ⟧s ρ ↘ ρσ ->
      ⟦ σ' : Δ ⟧s ρ' ↘ ρ'σ' ->
      (exists b b', ⟦ B[q σ] ⟧ ρ ↦ c ⦂ t1 ↘ b /\ ⟦ B ⟧ ρσ ↦ c' ⦂ t2 ↘ b' /\ Dom b ≈ b' ∈ per_univ j) /\
      (exists b b', ⟦ B ⟧ ρσ ↦ c ⦂ t2 ↘ b /\ ⟦ B ⟧ ρ'σ' ↦ c' ⦂ t3 ↘ b' /\ Dom b ≈ b' ∈ per_univ j) /\
      (exists b b', ⟦ B ⟧ ρ'σ' ↦ c ⦂ t3 ↘ b /\ ⟦ B[q σ'] ⟧ ρ' ↦ c' ⦂ t4 ↘ b' /\ Dom b ≈ b' ∈ per_univ j) /\
      rel_typ_kind B[q σ] (ρ ↦ c ⦂ t1) r.
Proof.
  intros * HΓ Hσj HA HB HBr * Hpair Hts Hev Hev'.
  pose proof (per_ctx_env_of_typ_sub (κ := κ) HΓ Hσj HA) as HΓA.
  pose proof (rel_sub_under_ctx_q (κ := κ) Hσj HA) as Hqj.
  pose proof (rel_type_inversion HB) as [env_relΔA [HΔA HBgen]].
  destruct (rel_sub_under_ctx_q_at HΓ HΔA Hσj HA _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hpair Hts Hev Hev')
    as [s [s' [Hq [Hq' Hchain]]]].
  destruct (HBgen _ _ HΓA _ _ Hqj _ _ _ _ Hpair Hq Hq')
    as [b1 b2 b3 b4 Hb1 Hb2 Hb3 Hb4 Hbchain].
  pose proof (rel_type_inversion_simple_at HΔA HB) as HBl.
The four bridges, at four pairs the chain above relates, and the lifted environment against itself, for the relevance.
  assert (P1 : Dom s ↦ c ⦂ centry_tag (ce_ass κ A) Δ s ≈ ρσ ↦ c' ⦂ t2 ∈ env_relΔA) by pairwise.
  assert (P2 : Dom ρσ ↦ c ⦂ t2 ≈ s ↦ c ⦂ centry_tag (ce_ass κ A) Δ s ∈ env_relΔA) by pairwise.
  assert (P3 : Dom s' ↦ c' ⦂ centry_tag (ce_ass κ A) Δ s' ≈ ρ'σ' ↦ c' ⦂ t3 ∈ env_relΔA) by pairwise.
  assert (P4 : Dom ρ'σ' ↦ c ⦂ t3 ≈ s' ↦ c' ⦂ centry_tag (ce_ass κ A) Δ s' ∈ env_relΔA) by pairwise.
  assert (P0 : Dom s ↦ c ⦂ centry_tag (ce_ass κ A) Δ s ≈ s ↦ c ⦂ centry_tag (ce_ass κ A) Δ s ∈ env_relΔA) by pairwise.
  destruct (HBl _ _ P1) as [x1 [x2 [Hx1 [Hx2 Hx]]]].
  destruct (HBl _ _ P2) as [y1 [y2 [Hy1 [Hy2 Hy]]]].
  destruct (HBl _ _ P3) as [z1 [z2 [Hz1 [Hz2 Hz]]]].
  destruct (HBl _ _ P4) as [u1 [u2 [Hu1 [Hu2 Hu]]]].
  destruct (HBr _ HΔA _ _ P0) as (w & Ew & Hrw).
  assert (x1 = b2) by (eapply functional_eval_exp; eassumption).
  assert (y2 = b2) by (eapply functional_eval_exp; eassumption).
  assert (z1 = b3) by (eapply functional_eval_exp; eassumption).
  assert (u2 = b3) by (eapply functional_eval_exp; eassumption).
  assert (w = b2) by (eapply functional_eval_exp; eassumption).
  subst.
  apply rel_chain_of_pair in Hx, Hy, Hz, Hu.
  assert (M1 : rel_chain (per_univ j) ([b1; b2; b3; b4; x2]))
    by (merge_rel_chain Hbchain Hx b2).
  assert (M2 : rel_chain (per_univ j) ([y1; b1; b2; b3; b4; x2]))
    by (merge_rel_chain M1 Hy b2).
  assert (M3 : rel_chain (per_univ j) ([y1; b1; b2; b3; b4; x2; z2]))
    by (merge_rel_chain M2 Hz b3).
  assert (M4 : rel_chain (per_univ j) ([u1; y1; b1; b2; b3; b4; x2; z2]))
    by (merge_rel_chain M3 Hu b3).
  repeat split.
  - exists b1, x2; repeat split; try eassumption.
    pairwise.
  - exists y1, z2; repeat split; try eassumption.
    pairwise.
  - exists u1, b4; repeat split; try eassumption.
    pairwise.
  - exists b1; split; [ exact Hb1 |].
    assert (H12 : Dom b1 ≈ b2 ∈ per_univ j) by pairwise.
    destruct H12 as [R12 H12]; exact (per_univ_elem_kind _ _ _ _ H12).
Qed.

The values of a domain of the kind κd at the environments of a stage of a semantic judgment: of the kind κd, at the outer left one too, which the chain relates to the inner one.
Lemma domain_kind_at_stage : forall {Γ A κd} {i : nat} {k : universe_index} {Γ' env_rel' σ σ' ρ ρ' ρσ ρ'σ' in_rel a1 a2 a3 a4},
    Γ ⊨ᵗ A ≈ A at i ->
    rel_type_kind Γ A κd ->
    EF Γ' ≈ Γ' ∈ per_ctx_env ↘ env_rel' ->
    Γ' ⊨ˢ σ ≈ σ' : Γ -> Dom ρ ≈ ρ' ∈ env_rel' -> ⟦ σ : Γ ⟧s ρ ↘ ρσ -> ⟦ σ' : Γ ⟧s ρ' ↘ ρ'σ' ->
    ⟦ A ⟧ ρσ ↘ a2 -> rel_chain (per_univ_elem k in_rel) ([a1; a2; a3; a4]) ->
    domain_kind a1 = κd.
Proof.
  intros * HA HAk HΓ' Hσj Hρ Hev Hev' Ha2 Hachain.
  pose proof (rel_type_inversion HA) as [env_relΓ [HΓ _]].
  assert (Hρσ : Dom ρσ ≈ ρ'σ' ∈ env_relΓ) by (eapply rel_sub_under_ctx_at'; eassumption).
  destruct (HAk _ HΓ _ _ Hρσ) as (a0 & Ea0 & <-).
  assert (a0 = a2) as -> by (eapply functional_eval_exp; eassumption).
  assert (H12 : DF a1 ≈ a2 ∈ per_univ_elem k ↘ in_rel) by pairwise.
  exact (per_univ_elem_kind _ _ _ _ H12).
Qed.

A Π out of a domain of the kind κd into a type of an evaluated kind κc (pi_kinds) is a type of the domain's index. The PER model relates its values whatever the codomain's sort: for example Π (n : ℕ) Level at κc = ak_level, which no rule types (pi_kinds), still has related values; the sort discipline is the typing's (wf_pi). Generalizing a member of a type of levels over the parameters of a unit reads such Πs.
Lemma rel_type_under_ctx_pi : forall {Γ κd κc A} {i : nat} {B},
    Γ ⊨ᵗ A ≈ A at i ->
    rel_type_kind Γ A κd ->
    Γ ▹{κd} A ⊨ᵗ B ≈ B at i ->
    rel_type_kind (Γ ▹{κd} A) B κc ->
    pi_kinds κd κc -> evaluated_kind κc ->
    Γ ⊨ᵗ a_pi κd κc A B ≈ a_pi κd κc A B at i.
Proof.
  intros * HA HAk HB HBr Hk Hev0.
  pose proof (rel_type_inversion HA) as [env_relΓ [HΓ HAgen]].
  econstructor; [ exact HΓ | |].
  2:{
A Π is not LevelSort.
      intros R HR ρ ρ' Hρ; destruct (rel_type_inversion_simple_at HR HA _ _ Hρ) as (a & _ & Ha & _ & _).
      exists (d_pi κd κc a ρ B); split; [ apply eval_exp_pi; exact Ha | discriminate ]. }
  intros Γ' env_rel' HΓ' σ σ' Hσj ρ ρ' ρσ ρ'σ' Hρ Hev Hev'.
  destruct (HAgen _ _ HΓ' _ _ Hσj _ _ _ _ Hρ Hev Hev') as [a1 a2 a3 a4 Ha1 Ha2 Ha3 Ha4 Hachain].
  functionalize_per_univ_chain Hachain in_rel.
  pose proof (domain_kind_at_stage HA HAk HΓ' Hσj Hρ Hev Hev' Ha2 Hachain) as Hd1.
  apply (mk_rel_exp (d_pi κd κc a1 ρ B[q σ]) (d_pi κd κc a2 ρσ B) (d_pi κd κc a3 ρ'σ' B) (d_pi κd κc a4 ρ' B[q σ']));
    [ apply eval_exp_pi; exact Ha1 | apply eval_exp_pi; exact Ha2
    | apply eval_exp_pi; exact Ha3 | apply eval_exp_pi; exact Ha4 |].
  eapply rel_chain_mono; [ intros ? ? Hp; eexists; exact Hp |].
  eapply per_univ_elem_pi_chain;
    [ exact Hachain | | | | | exact Hd1 | exact Hk | exact Hev0
    | exact (domain_not_level_sort_at_stage HA HΓ' Hσj Hρ Hev Hev' Ha2 Hachain) | ];
    intros c c' Hc;
    pose proof (args_readable_of_chain Hachain Hc) as Hts;
    inversion Hts as [| ? ? [Hr1 Hr1'] Hts2]; subst; inversion Hts2 as [| ? ? [Hr2 Hr2'] Hts3]; subst;
      inversion Hts3 as [| ? ? [Hr3 Hr3'] Hts4]; subst; inversion Hts4 as [| ? ? [Hr4 Hr4'] _]; subst;
    pose proof (per_env_extend_sub_intro HΓ' Hσj HA _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hρ Ha1
                  ltac:(pairwise) Hc Hr1 Hr4') as Hpair;
    first [ exact (rel_type_not_level_sort_under_ctx_q HΓ' Hσj HA HB _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hpair Hts Hev Hev')
          | destruct (rel_type_under_ctx_q HΓ' Hσj HA HB HBr _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hpair Hts Hev Hev')
              as [O1 [O2 [O3 O4]]]; eassumption ].
Qed.

The four values of a Π into a type of an evaluated kind, as rel_typ_of_pi gives them for a codomain in a universe.
Lemma rel_typ_of_pi_evaluated : forall {Γ κd κc A A'} {i : nat} {B},
    Γ ⊨ᵗ A ≈ A at i ->
    Γ ⊨ᵗ A ≈ A' at i ->
    rel_type_kind Γ A κd ->
    Γ ▹{κd} A ⊨ᵗ B ≈ B at i ->
    rel_type_kind (Γ ▹{κd} A) B κc ->
    pi_kinds κd κc -> evaluated_kind κc ->
    forall Γ' env_rel',
      EF Γ' ≈ Γ' ∈ per_ctx_env ↘ env_rel' ->
      forall σ σ' ρ ρ' ρσ ρ'σ',
        Γ' ⊨ˢ σ ≈ σ' : Γ ->
        Dom ρ ≈ ρ' ∈ env_rel' ->
        ⟦ σ : Γ ⟧s ρ ↘ ρσ ->
        ⟦ σ' : Γ ⟧s ρ' ↘ ρ'σ' ->
        exists in_rel a1 a2 a3 a4,
          ⟦ A[σ] ⟧ ρ ↘ a1 /\
          ⟦ A ⟧ ρσ ↘ a2 /\
          ⟦ A' ⟧ ρ'σ' ↘ a3 /\
          ⟦ A'[σ'] ⟧ ρ' ↘ a4 /\
          DF a1 ≈ a4 ∈ per_univ_elem i ↘ in_rel /\
          DF a2 ≈ a3 ∈ per_univ_elem i ↘ in_rel /\
          Definitions.rel_typ i (a_pi κd κc A B) σ ρ ρσ (a_pi κd κc A' B) σ' ρ' ρ'σ'
            (per_pi a2 a3 in_rel B ρσ B ρ'σ').
Proof.
  intros * HAself HA HAk HB HBr Hk Hev0 * HΓ' * Hσj Hρ Hev Hev'.
  pose proof (rel_type_inversion HA) as [env_relΓ [HΓ HAgen]].
  destruct (HAgen _ _ HΓ' _ _ Hσj _ _ _ _ Hρ Hev Hev')
    as [a1 a2 a3 a4 Ha1 Ha2 Ha3 Ha4 Hachain].
  functionalize_per_univ_chain Hachain in_rel.
  pose proof (domain_kind_at_stage HAself HAk HΓ' Hσj Hρ Hev Hev' Ha2 Hachain) as Hd1.
  exists in_rel, a1, a2, a3, a4.
  do 4 (split; [ eassumption |]).
  do 2 (split; [ pairwise |]).
  apply (mk_rel_exp (d_pi κd κc a1 ρ B[q σ]) (d_pi κd κc a2 ρσ B)
                    (d_pi κd κc a3 ρ'σ' B) (d_pi κd κc a4 ρ' B[q σ']));
    [ apply eval_exp_pi; exact Ha1 | apply eval_exp_pi; exact Ha2
    | apply eval_exp_pi; exact Ha3 | apply eval_exp_pi; exact Ha4 |].
  eapply per_univ_elem_pi_chain;
    [ exact Hachain | | | | | exact Hd1 | exact Hk | exact Hev0
    | exact (domain_not_level_sort_at_stage HA HΓ' Hσj Hρ Hev Hev' Ha2 Hachain) | ];
    intros c c' Hc;
    pose proof (args_readable_of_chain Hachain Hc) as Hts;
    inversion Hts as [| ? ? [Hr1 Hr1'] Hts2]; subst; inversion Hts2 as [| ? ? [Hr2 Hr2'] Hts3]; subst;
      inversion Hts3 as [| ? ? [Hr3 Hr3'] Hts4]; subst; inversion Hts4 as [| ? ? [Hr4 Hr4'] _]; subst;
    pose proof (per_env_extend_sub_intro HΓ' Hσj HAself _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hρ Ha1
                  ltac:(pairwise) Hc Hr1 Hr4') as Hpair;
    first [ exact (rel_type_not_level_sort_under_ctx_q HΓ' Hσj HAself HB _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hpair Hts Hev Hev')
          | destruct (rel_type_under_ctx_q HΓ' Hσj HAself HB HBr _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hpair Hts Hev Hev')
              as [O1 [O2 [O3 O4]]]; eassumption ].
Qed.

A Π is of the kind of its codomain.
Lemma rel_type_kind_pi : forall {Γ κd κc A} {i : nat} {B}, Γ ⊨ᵗ A ≈ A at i -> rel_type_kind Γ (a_pi κd κc A B) κc.
Proof.
  intros * HA R HR ρ ρ' Hρ.
  destruct (rel_type_inversion_simple_at HR HA _ _ Hρ) as (a & _ & Ha & _ & _).
  exists (d_pi κd κc a ρ B); split; [ apply eval_exp_pi; exact Ha | reflexivity ].
Qed.

The Small Π at a Level Term

The codomain is at the weakened level L[↑]ʷ, whose value at an extended environment has the realiser of L's at the tail: the two are related levels, through L's judgment along Wk (rel_exp_under_ctx_shift_at).
Lemma suniv_real_shift : forall {Δ κ A L} {i n : nat} {env_relΔA},
    Δ ⊨ᵗ A ≈ A at i ->
    Δ ⊨ L : Level@n ->
    EF Δ ▹{κ} A ≈ Δ ▹{κ} A ∈ per_ctx_env ↘ env_relΔA ->
    forall e x e' x' et et' t1 t2,
      Dom e ↦ x ⦂ et ≈ e' ↦ x' ⦂ et' ∈ env_relΔA ->
      ⟦ L[↑]ʷ ⟧ e ↦ x ⦂ et ↘ t1 ->
      ⟦ L ⟧ e' ↘ t2 ->
      domain_level_real t1 = domain_level_real t2.
Proof.
  intros * HA HL HΔA * Hee Ht1 Ht2.
  pose proof (rel_exp_of_level_inversion HL) as [env_relΔ [HΔ _]].
  pose proof (per_ctx_env_of_typ (κ := κ) HΔ HA) as HΔA'.
  handle_per_ctx_env_irrel.
  assert (Hlr : forall ρ ρ', Dom ρ ≈ ρ' ∈ env_relΔ -> rel_typ_evaluated Level@n ρ)
    by (intros; eexists; split; [ apply eval_exp_level | constructor ]).
  destruct (rel_exp_under_ctx_shift_at HΔ HA HL Hlr _ _ _ _ _ _ Hee)
    as (j & R & b1 & b2 & b3 & b4 & w1 & w2 & w3 & w4 & Hb1 & Hb2 & Hb3 & Hb4 & HR1 & HR2 & Hw1 & Hw2 & Hw3 & Hw4 & Hwc).
  cbn [exp_wk] in Hb1, Hb4.
  simplify_evals.
  match goal with H : per_univ_elem _ _ (Levelᵈ@_) (Levelᵈ@_) |- _ => invert_per_univ_elem H end.
  apply_relation_equivalence.
  assert (Hw : per_lvl t1 t2) by lvl_pw.
  exact (per_lvl_real _ _ Hw).
Qed.

rel_exp_of_univ_under_ctx_q for a codomain in the small universe at the weakened level: the five instantiations have the realisers of L[↑]ʷ at extended environments related to ρσ ↦ c, which are L's at ρσ (suniv_real_shift), so all five chains are in one small universe, of types of the relevant kind.
Lemma rel_exp_of_suniv_under_ctx_q : forall {Γ Δ σ σ' κ A} {i n : nat} {B B' L env_relΓ},
    EF Γ ≈ Γ ∈ per_ctx_env ↘ env_relΓ ->
    Γ ⊨ˢ σ ≈ σ' : Δ ->
    Δ ⊨ᵗ A ≈ A at i ->
    Δ ⊨ L : Level@n ->
    Δ ▹{κ} A ⊨ B ≈ B' : Type⟨L[↑]ʷ⟩ ->
    forall ρ ρ' ρσ ρ'σ' c c' t1 t2 t3 t4 t,
      Dom ρ ↦ c ⦂ t1 ≈ ρ' ↦ c' ⦂ t4 ∈ per_env_extend A[σ] A[σ] env_relΓ ->
      args_readable_at c c' ([t1; t2; t3; t4]) ->
      ⟦ σ : Δ ⟧s ρ ↘ ρσ ->
      ⟦ σ' : Δ ⟧s ρ' ↘ ρ'σ' ->
      ⟦ L ⟧ ρσ ↘ t ->
      rel_typ_kind B[q σ] (ρ ↦ c ⦂ t1) ak_relevant /\
      (exists b b',
          ⟦ B[q σ] ⟧ ρ ↦ c ⦂ t1 ↘ b /\ ⟦ B ⟧ ρσ ↦ c' ⦂ t2 ↘ b' /\
          Dom b ≈ b' ∈ per_universe_elements (per_univ (us (domain_level_real t)))) /\
      (exists b b',
          ⟦ B ⟧ ρσ ↦ c ⦂ t2 ↘ b /\ ⟦ B' ⟧ ρ'σ' ↦ c' ⦂ t3 ↘ b' /\
          Dom b ≈ b' ∈ per_universe_elements (per_univ (us (domain_level_real t)))) /\
      (exists b b',
          ⟦ B' ⟧ ρ'σ' ↦ c ⦂ t3 ↘ b /\ ⟦ B'[q σ'] ⟧ ρ' ↦ c' ⦂ t4 ↘ b' /\
          Dom b ≈ b' ∈ per_universe_elements (per_univ (us (domain_level_real t)))).
Proof.
  intros * HΓ Hσj HA HL HB * Hpair Hts Hev Hev' Ht.
  pose proof (per_ctx_env_of_typ_sub (κ := κ) HΓ Hσj HA) as HΓA.
  pose proof (rel_sub_under_ctx_q (κ := κ) Hσj HA) as Hqj.
  pose proof (rel_exp_of_suniv_tm_inversion HB) as [env_relΔA [HΔA HBgen]].
  pose proof (rel_exp_of_suniv_tm_inversion_simple (rel_exp_under_ctx_refl_left HB))
    as [env_relΔA2 [HΔA2 HBl]].
  pose proof (rel_exp_of_suniv_tm_inversion_simple (rel_exp_under_ctx_refl_right HB))
    as [env_relΔA3 [HΔA3 HBr]].
  handle_per_ctx_env_irrel.
  destruct (rel_sub_under_ctx_q_at HΓ HΔA3 Hσj HA _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hpair Hts Hev Hev')
    as [s [s' [Hq [Hq' Hchain]]]].
  destruct (HBgen _ _ HΓA _ _ Hqj _ _ _ _ Hpair Hq Hq')
    as [t0 [Ht0 [b1 b2 b3 b4 Hb1 Hb2 Hb3 Hb4 Hbchain]]].
  assert (Hrel : rel_typ_kind B[q σ] (ρ ↦ c ⦂ t1) ak_relevant)
    by (exists b1; split; [ exact Hb1 | destruct Hbchain as [[_ Hr _] _]; exact Hr ]).
  assert (P1 : Dom s ↦ c ⦂ centry_tag (ce_ass κ A) Δ s ≈ ρσ ↦ c' ⦂ t2 ∈ env_relΔA) by pairwise.
  assert (P2 : Dom ρσ ↦ c ⦂ t2 ≈ s ↦ c ⦂ centry_tag (ce_ass κ A) Δ s ∈ env_relΔA) by pairwise.
  assert (P3 : Dom s' ↦ c' ⦂ centry_tag (ce_ass κ A) Δ s' ≈ ρ'σ' ↦ c' ⦂ t3 ∈ env_relΔA) by pairwise.
  assert (P4 : Dom ρ'σ' ↦ c ⦂ t3 ≈ s' ↦ c' ⦂ centry_tag (ce_ass κ A) Δ s' ∈ env_relΔA) by pairwise.
  destruct (HBl _ _ P1) as [x1 [x2 [l1 [Hx1 [Hx2 [Hl1 Hx]]]]]].
  destruct (HBl _ _ P2) as [y1 [y2 [l2 [Hy1 [Hy2 [Hl2 Hy]]]]]].
  destruct (HBr _ _ P3) as [z1 [z2 [l3 [Hz1 [Hz2 [Hl3 Hz]]]]]].
  destruct (HBr _ _ P4) as [u1 [u2 [l4 [Hu1 [Hu2 [Hl4 Hu]]]]]].
All five realisers are L's at ρσ.
  assert (R0 : domain_level_real t0 = domain_level_real t)
    by (eapply (suniv_real_shift HA HL HΔA3 s c ρσ c (centry_tag (ce_ass κ A) Δ s) t2); [ pairwise | exact Ht0 | exact Ht ]).
  assert (R1 : domain_level_real l1 = domain_level_real t)
    by (eapply (suniv_real_shift HA HL HΔA3 s c ρσ c (centry_tag (ce_ass κ A) Δ s) t2); [ pairwise | exact Hl1 | exact Ht ]).
  assert (R2 : domain_level_real l2 = domain_level_real t)
    by (eapply (suniv_real_shift HA HL HΔA3 ρσ c ρσ c t2 t2); [ pairwise | exact Hl2 | exact Ht ]).
  assert (R3 : domain_level_real l3 = domain_level_real t)
    by (eapply (suniv_real_shift HA HL HΔA3 s' c' ρσ c (centry_tag (ce_ass κ A) Δ s') t2); [ pairwise | exact Hl3 | exact Ht ]).
  assert (R4 : domain_level_real l4 = domain_level_real t)
    by (eapply (suniv_real_shift HA HL HΔA3 ρ'σ' c ρσ c t3 t2); [ pairwise | exact Hl4 | exact Ht ]).
  rewrite R0 in Hbchain; rewrite R1 in Hx; rewrite R2 in Hy; rewrite R3 in Hz; rewrite R4 in Hu.
  assert (x1 = b2) by (eapply functional_eval_exp; eassumption).
  assert (y2 = b2) by (eapply functional_eval_exp; eassumption).
  assert (z1 = b3) by (eapply functional_eval_exp; eassumption).
  assert (u2 = b3) by (eapply functional_eval_exp; eassumption).
  subst.
  apply rel_chain_of_pair in Hx, Hy, Hz, Hu.
  set (j := us (domain_level_real t)) in *.
  assert (M1 : rel_chain (per_universe_elements (per_univ j)) ([b1; b2; b3; b4; x2]))
    by (merge_rel_chain Hbchain Hx b2).
  assert (M2 : rel_chain (per_universe_elements (per_univ j)) ([y1; b1; b2; b3; b4; x2]))
    by (merge_rel_chain M1 Hy b2).
  assert (M3 : rel_chain (per_universe_elements (per_univ j)) ([y1; b1; b2; b3; b4; x2; z2]))
    by (merge_rel_chain M2 Hz b3).
  assert (M4 : rel_chain (per_universe_elements (per_univ j)) ([u1; y1; b1; b2; b3; b4; x2; z2]))
    by (merge_rel_chain M3 Hu b3).
  split; [ exact Hrel |].
  split; [| split ].
  - exists b1, x2; split; [ eassumption | split; [ eassumption | pairwise ] ].
  - exists y1, z2; split; [ eassumption | split; [ eassumption | pairwise ] ].
  - exists u1, b4; split; [ eassumption | split; [ eassumption | pairwise ] ].
Qed.

The four values of a domain of the small Π at a level, at the realiser of the level's inner value: a type of the small universe there, a proposition, or a type of levels, as its kind κd says.
Lemma rel_domain_suniv_at : forall {Γ L A A' κd},
    Γ ⊨ A ≈ A' : abs_kind_sort κd Type⟨L⟩ ->
    exists env_rel (_ : EF Γ ≈ Γ ∈ per_ctx_env ↘ env_rel),
    forall Γ' env_rel' (_ : EF Γ' ≈ Γ' ∈ per_ctx_env ↘ env_rel') σ σ',
      Γ' ⊨ˢ σ ≈ σ' : Γ ->
      forall ρ ρ' ρσ ρ'σ' t,
        Dom ρ ≈ ρ' ∈ env_rel' ->
        ⟦ σ : Γ ⟧s ρ ↘ ρσ ->
        ⟦ σ' : Γ ⟧s ρ' ↘ ρ'σ' ->
        ⟦ L ⟧ ρσ ↘ t ->
        rel_exp A σ ρ ρσ A' σ' ρ' ρ'σ' (per_univ (us (domain_level_real t))).
Proof.
  intros * HA; destruct κd; cbn [abs_kind_sort] in HA.
  - pose proof (rel_exp_of_suniv_tm_inversion HA) as [env_relΓ [HΓ HAgen]].
    eexists; eexists; [ eassumption |].
    intros * HΓ' * Hσj * Hρ Hev Hev' Ht.
    destruct (HAgen _ _ HΓ' _ _ Hσj _ _ _ _ Hρ Hev Hev') as [t' [Ht' [a1 a2 a3 a4 Ha1 Ha2 Ha3 Ha4 Hc]]].
    assert (t' = t) as -> by (eapply functional_eval_exp; eassumption).
    econstructor; try eassumption.
    eapply rel_chain_mono; [| exact Hc ]; intros ? ? Hx; exact (per_universe_elements_univ_rel Hx).
  - pose proof (rel_exp_of_prop_inversion HA) as [env_relΓ [HΓ HAgen]].
    eexists; eexists; [ eassumption |].
    intros * HΓ' * Hσj * Hρ Hev Hev' Ht.
    destruct (HAgen _ _ HΓ' _ _ Hσj _ _ _ _ Hρ Hev Hev') as [a1 a2 a3 a4 Ha1 Ha2 Ha3 Ha4 Hc].
    econstructor; try eassumption.
    eapply rel_chain_mono; [| exact Hc ]; intros ? ? Hp; eexists; exact (per_univ_elem_of_prop _ _ _ Hp).
  - pose proof (rel_exp_of_level_sort_inversion HA) as [env_relΓ [HΓ HAgen]].
    eexists; eexists; [ eassumption |].
    intros * HΓ' * Hσj * Hρ Hev Hev' Ht.
    destruct (HAgen _ _ HΓ' _ _ Hσj _ _ _ _ Hρ Hev Hev') as [a1 a2 a3 a4 Ha1 Ha2 Ha3 Ha4 Hc].
    econstructor; try eassumption.
    eapply rel_chain_mono; [| exact Hc ]; intros ? ? Hp; exact (per_univ_elem_of_level_sort _ _ _ Hp).
Qed.

A domain of the small Π at a level is a type of index 0.
Lemma rel_type_of_domain_suniv : forall {Γ L A A' κd},
    Γ ⊨ A ≈ A' : abs_kind_sort κd Type⟨L⟩ ->
    Γ ⊨ᵗ A ≈ A' at 0.
Proof.
  intros * HA; destruct κd; cbn [abs_kind_sort] in HA;
    [ exact (rel_type_of_typ (rel_exp_suniv_tm_large (i := 0) HA)) | exact (rel_type_of_prop 0 HA)
    | exact (rel_type_of_level_sort 0 HA) ].
Qed.

A domain of the small Π at a level is of its kind.
Lemma rel_type_kind_of_domain_suniv : forall {Γ L A A' κd},
    Γ ⊨ A ≈ A' : abs_kind_sort κd Type⟨L⟩ ->
    rel_type_kind Γ A κd.
Proof.
  intros * HA R HR ρ ρ' Hρ; destruct κd; cbn [abs_kind_sort] in HA.
  - exact (rel_exp_of_typ_relevant_at HR (rel_exp_suniv_tm_large (i := 0) (rel_exp_under_ctx_refl_left HA)) _ _ Hρ).
  - destruct (rel_exp_of_prop_inversion_simple_at HR (rel_exp_under_ctx_refl_left HA) _ _ Hρ) as (a & a' & Ea & _ & Hp).
    exists a; split; [ exact Ea | exact (per_prop_left _ _ Hp) ].
  - exact (rel_exp_of_level_sort_kind_at HR (rel_exp_under_ctx_refl_left HA) _ _ Hρ).
Qed.

The small Π at a level term: at each pair of environments it is the small Π at the realiser of the level's value, whose codomain obligations rel_exp_of_suniv_under_ctx_q discharges.
Lemma rel_exp_under_ctx_pi_cong_small : forall {Γ L κd A A' B B'} {n : nat},
    Γ ⊨ L : Level@n ->
    Γ ⊨ A : abs_kind_sort κd Type⟨L⟩ ->
    Γ ⊨ A ≈ A' : abs_kind_sort κd Type⟨L⟩ ->
    Γ ▹{κd} A ⊨ B ≈ B' : Type⟨L[↑]ʷ⟩ ->
    Γ ⊨ Π{κd} A B ≈ Π{κd} A' B' : Type⟨L⟩.
Proof.
  intros * HL HA0 HA HB.
  pose proof (rel_type_of_domain_suniv HA0) as HAself.
  pose proof (rel_type_kind_of_domain_suniv HA0) as HAk.
  pose proof (rel_domain_suniv_at HA) as [env_relΓ [HΓ HAgen]].
  apply (rel_exp_of_suniv_tm (n := n)); [ exact HL |].
  eexists; eexists; [ eassumption |].
  intros Γ' env_rel' HΓ' σ σ' Hσj ρ ρ' ρσ ρ'σ' Hρ Hev Hev' t Ht.
  destruct (HAgen _ _ HΓ' _ _ Hσj _ _ _ _ _ Hρ Hev Hev' Ht)
    as [a1 a2 a3 a4 Ha1 Ha2 Ha3 Ha4 Hachain].
  functionalize_per_univ_chain Hachain in_rel.
  pose proof (domain_kind_at_stage HAself HAk HΓ' Hσj Hρ Hev Hev' Ha2 Hachain) as Hd1.
  apply (mk_rel_exp Πᵈ{κd} a1 ρ B[q σ] Πᵈ{κd} a2 ρσ B
                    Πᵈ{κd} a3 ρ'σ' B' Πᵈ{κd} a4 ρ' B'[q σ']);
    [ apply eval_exp_pi; exact Ha1 | apply eval_exp_pi; exact Ha2
    | apply eval_exp_pi; exact Ha3 | apply eval_exp_pi; exact Ha4 |].
  set (j := us (domain_level_real t)) in *.
The codomain obligations at a related pair of arguments, each tagged with the entry type of its own extension.
  assert (Hobl : forall c c', Dom c ≈ c' ∈ in_rel ->
             rel_typ_kind B[q σ] (ρ ↦ c ⦂ entry_type_value a1) ak_relevant /\
             (exists b b',
                 ⟦ B[q σ] ⟧ ρ ↦ c ⦂ entry_type_value a1 ↘ b /\ ⟦ B ⟧ ρσ ↦ c' ⦂ entry_type_value a2 ↘ b' /\
                 Dom b ≈ b' ∈ per_universe_elements (per_univ j)) /\
             (exists b b',
                 ⟦ B ⟧ ρσ ↦ c ⦂ entry_type_value a2 ↘ b /\ ⟦ B' ⟧ ρ'σ' ↦ c' ⦂ entry_type_value a3 ↘ b' /\
                 Dom b ≈ b' ∈ per_universe_elements (per_univ j)) /\
             (exists b b',
                 ⟦ B' ⟧ ρ'σ' ↦ c ⦂ entry_type_value a3 ↘ b /\ ⟦ B'[q σ'] ⟧ ρ' ↦ c' ⦂ entry_type_value a4 ↘ b' /\
                 Dom b ≈ b' ∈ per_universe_elements (per_univ j))).
  { intros c c' Hc.
    pose proof (args_readable_of_chain Hachain Hc) as Hts.
    assert (H14 : DF a1 ≈ a4 ∈ per_univ_elem j ↘ in_rel) by pairwise.
    pose proof (entry_readable_of_elem H14 Hc) as [Hr1 Hr4].
    pose proof (per_env_extend_sub_intro HΓ' Hσj HAself _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hρ Ha1
                  ltac:(pairwise) Hc Hr1 Hr4) as Hpair.
    exact (rel_exp_of_suniv_under_ctx_q HΓ' Hσj HAself HL HB _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ t Hpair Hts Hev Hev' Ht). }
  apply (rel_chain_pi_relevant (i := j) (R := per_pi a2 a3 in_rel B ρσ B' ρ'σ')).
  eapply per_univ_elem_pi_chain;
    [ exact Hachain | | | | | exact Hd1 | constructor | constructor
    | exact (domain_not_level_sort_at_stage HAself HΓ' Hσj Hρ Hev Hev' Ha2 Hachain) | ];
    intros c c' Hc;
    destruct (Hobl _ _ Hc)
      as (Or & (b1 & b1' & E1 & E1' & H1) & (b2 & b2' & E2 & E2' & H2) & (b3 & b3' & E3 & E3' & H3));
    first [ exact Or
          | exists b1, b1'; split; [ exact E1 | split; [ exact E1' | exact (per_universe_elements_univ_rel H1) ] ]
          | exists b2, b2'; split; [ exact E2 | split; [ exact E2' | exact (per_universe_elements_univ_rel H2) ] ]
          | exists b3, b3'; split; [ exact E3 | split; [ exact E3' | exact (per_universe_elements_univ_rel H3) ] ]
          | exists b1; split; [ exact E1 | exact (per_universe_elements_left_not_level_sort _ _ _ H1) ] ].
