The Universal Proposition

A ∀ is a proposition by its head, and two ∀s read back equally when their domains do and their bodies do under the fresh variable of the domain, which is related to itself at the domain's element PER (realisability). The bodies are propositions, related at per_prop at every related pair of arguments.
Lemma per_prop_all : forall {k R κd a a' ρ ρ' B B'},
    DF a ≈ a' ∈ per_univ_elem k ↘ R ->
    not_level_sort a ->
    (forall c c', Dom c ≈ c' ∈ R ->
        exists b b', ⟦ B ⟧ ρ ↦ c ⦂ entry_type_value a ↘ b /\ ⟦ B' ⟧ ρ' ↦ c' ⦂ entry_type_value a' ↘ b' /\
                     Dom b ≈ b' ∈ per_prop) ->
    Dom ∀ₚᵈ{κd} a ρ B ≈ ∀ₚᵈ{κd} a' ρ' B' ∈ per_prop.
Proof.
  intros * Ha Hna HB.
  constructor; [ reflexivity | reflexivity |].
  intros s.
  destruct (per_univ_then_per_top_typ Ha s) as [A A' HA HA' HEA].
  pose proof (var_per_elem s Ha Hna) as Hvar.
  destruct (HB _ _ Hvar) as [b [b' [Hb [Hb' [_ _ Hbb]]]]].
  destruct (Hbb (S s)) as [P P' HP HP' HEP].
  apply (mk_type_reads_alike _ _ _ (∀ₚⁿ{κd} A P) (∀ₚⁿ{κd} A' P'));
    [ eapply read_typ_pi; eassumption | eapply read_typ_pi; eassumption | apply nf_pi_upto_proofs; assumption ].
Qed.

Lemma rel_exp_under_ctx_all : forall {Γ κd A A'} {i : nat} {B B'},
    Γ ⊨ᵗ A ≈ A at i ->
    Γ ⊨ᵗ A ≈ A' at i ->
    Γ ▹{κd} A ⊨ B ≈ B' : Propₘ ->
    Γ ⊨ ∀ₚ{κd} A B ≈ ∀ₚ{κd} A' B' : Propₘ.
Proof.
  intros * HAself HA HB.
  pose proof (rel_type_inversion HA) as [env_relΓ [HΓ HAgen]].
  apply rel_exp_of_prop; eexists; eexists; [ eassumption |].
  intros Γ' env_rel' HΓ' σ σ' Hσj ρ ρ' ρσ ρ'σ' Hρ Hev Hev'.
  destruct (HAgen _ _ HΓ' _ _ Hσj _ _ _ _ Hρ Hev Hev')
    as [a1 a2 a3 a4 Ha1 Ha2 Ha3 Ha4 Hachain].
  functionalize_per_univ_chain Hachain in_rel.
  assert (Ha14 : DF a1 ≈ a4 ∈ per_univ_elem i ↘ in_rel) by pairwise.
The bodies at every related pair of arguments, along the three links.
  assert (Hq : forall c c', Dom c ≈ c' ∈ in_rel ->
             (exists b b', ⟦ B[q σ] ⟧ ρ ↦ c ⦂ entry_type_value a1 ↘ b /\ ⟦ B ⟧ ρσ ↦ c' ⦂ entry_type_value a2 ↘ b' /\
                           Dom b ≈ b' ∈ per_prop) /\
             (exists b b', ⟦ B ⟧ ρσ ↦ c ⦂ entry_type_value a2 ↘ b /\ ⟦ B' ⟧ ρ'σ' ↦ c' ⦂ entry_type_value a3 ↘ b' /\
                           Dom b ≈ b' ∈ per_prop) /\
             (exists b b', ⟦ B' ⟧ ρ'σ' ↦ c ⦂ entry_type_value a3 ↘ b /\ ⟦ B'[q σ'] ⟧ ρ' ↦ c' ⦂ entry_type_value a4 ↘ b' /\
                           Dom b ≈ b' ∈ per_prop)).
  { intros c c' Hc.
    pose proof (args_readable_of_chain Hachain Hc) as Hts.
    pose proof (entry_readable_of_elem Ha14 Hc) as [Hr1 Hr4].
    pose proof (per_env_extend_sub_intro HΓ' Hσj HAself _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hρ Ha1 Ha14 Hc Hr1 Hr4) as Hpair.
    exact (rel_exp_of_prop_under_ctx_q HΓ' Hσj HAself HB _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hpair Hts Hev Hev'). }
  
The domains are not LevelSort, along the chain.
  pose proof (domain_not_level_sort_at_stage HA HΓ' Hσj Hρ Hev Hev' Ha2 Hachain) as Hn1.
  destruct Hachain as (H12 & H23 & H34).
  pose proof (proj1 (per_univ_elem_not_level_sort_iff _ _ _ _ H12) Hn1) as Hn2.
  pose proof (proj1 (per_univ_elem_not_level_sort_iff _ _ _ _ H23) Hn2) as Hn3.
  apply (mk_rel_exp ∀ₚᵈ{κd} a1 ρ B[q σ] ∀ₚᵈ{κd} a2 ρσ B ∀ₚᵈ{κd} a3 ρ'σ' B' ∀ₚᵈ{κd} a4 ρ' B'[q σ']);
    [ apply eval_exp_pi; exact Ha1 | apply eval_exp_pi; exact Ha2
    | apply eval_exp_pi; exact Ha3 | apply eval_exp_pi; exact Ha4 |].
  apply rel_chain_4.
  - eapply per_prop_all; [ exact H12 | exact Hn1 |]; intros c c' Hc; exact (proj1 (Hq _ _ Hc)).
  - eapply per_prop_all; [ exact H23 | exact Hn2 |]; intros c c' Hc; exact (proj1 (proj2 (Hq _ _ Hc))).
  - eapply per_prop_all; [ exact H34 | exact Hn3 |]; intros c c' Hc; exact (proj2 (proj2 (Hq _ _ Hc))).
Qed.

Hint Resolve rel_exp_under_ctx_all : mctt.

The Π between Types of Levels

A Π between types of levels is one: its four values are related types of levels (per_level_code_pi), their codomains related types of levels at related arguments. For example ⋅ ⊨ Π Level@0 Level@1 : LevelSort.
A type of levels in an extended context along a lifted substitution, at three pairs of arguments, in per_level_sort: the proof of rel_exp_of_univ_under_ctx_q, at LevelSort rather than at a universe.
Lemma rel_exp_of_level_sort_under_ctx_q : forall {Γ Δ σ σ' κ A} {i : nat} {B B' env_relΓ},
    EF Γ ≈ Γ ∈ per_ctx_env ↘ env_relΓ ->
    Γ ⊨ˢ σ ≈ σ' : Δ ->
    Δ ⊨ᵗ A ≈ A at i ->
    Δ ▹{κ} A ⊨ B ≈ B' : LevelSort ->
    forall ρ ρ' ρσ ρ'σ' c c' t1 t2 t3 t4,
      Dom ρ ↦ c ⦂ t1 ≈ ρ' ↦ c' ⦂ t4 ∈ per_env_extend A[σ] A[σ] env_relΓ ->
      args_readable_at c c' ([t1; t2; t3; t4]) ->
      ⟦ σ : Δ ⟧s ρ ↘ ρσ ->
      ⟦ σ' : Δ ⟧s ρ' ↘ ρ'σ' ->
      (exists b b',
          ⟦ B[q σ] ⟧ ρ ↦ c ⦂ t1 ↘ b /\ ⟦ B ⟧ ρσ ↦ c' ⦂ t2 ↘ b' /\
          Dom b ≈ b' ∈ per_level_sort) /\
      (exists b b',
          ⟦ B ⟧ ρσ ↦ c ⦂ t2 ↘ b /\ ⟦ B' ⟧ ρ'σ' ↦ c' ⦂ t3 ↘ b' /\
          Dom b ≈ b' ∈ per_level_sort) /\
      (exists b b',
          ⟦ B' ⟧ ρ'σ' ↦ c ⦂ t3 ↘ b /\ ⟦ B'[q σ'] ⟧ ρ' ↦ c' ⦂ t4 ↘ b' /\
          Dom b ≈ b' ∈ per_level_sort).
Proof.
  intros * HΓ Hσj HA HB * Hpair Hts Hev Hev'.
  pose proof (per_ctx_env_of_typ_sub (κ := κ) HΓ Hσj HA) as HΓA.
  pose proof (rel_sub_under_ctx_q (κ := κ) Hσj HA) as Hqj.
  pose proof (rel_exp_of_level_sort_inversion HB) as [env_relΔA [HΔA HBgen]].
  pose proof (rel_exp_of_level_sort_inversion_simple_at HΔA (rel_exp_under_ctx_refl_left HB)) as HBl.
  pose proof (rel_exp_of_level_sort_inversion_simple_at HΔA (rel_exp_under_ctx_refl_right HB)) as HBr.
  destruct (rel_sub_under_ctx_q_at HΓ HΔA Hσj HA _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hpair Hts Hev Hev')
    as [s [s' [Hq [Hq' Hchain]]]].
  destruct (HBgen _ _ HΓA _ _ Hqj _ _ _ _ Hpair Hq Hq')
    as [b1 b2 b3 b4 Hb1 Hb2 Hb3 Hb4 Hbchain].
The four bridges, at four pairs the chain above relates.
  assert (P1 : Dom s ↦ c ⦂ centry_tag (ce_ass κ A) Δ s ≈ ρσ ↦ c' ⦂ t2 ∈ env_relΔA) by pairwise.
  assert (P2 : Dom ρσ ↦ c ⦂ t2 ≈ s ↦ c ⦂ centry_tag (ce_ass κ A) Δ s ∈ env_relΔA) by pairwise.
  assert (P3 : Dom s' ↦ c' ⦂ centry_tag (ce_ass κ A) Δ s' ≈ ρ'σ' ↦ c' ⦂ t3 ∈ env_relΔA) by pairwise.
  assert (P4 : Dom ρ'σ' ↦ c ⦂ t3 ≈ s' ↦ c' ⦂ centry_tag (ce_ass κ A) Δ s' ∈ env_relΔA) by pairwise.
  destruct (HBl _ _ P1) as [x1 [x2 [Hx1 [Hx2 Hx]]]].
  destruct (HBl _ _ P2) as [y1 [y2 [Hy1 [Hy2 Hy]]]].
  destruct (HBr _ _ P3) as [z1 [z2 [Hz1 [Hz2 Hz]]]].
  destruct (HBr _ _ P4) as [u1 [u2 [Hu1 [Hu2 Hu]]]].
  assert (x1 = b2) by (eapply functional_eval_exp; eassumption).
  assert (y2 = b2) by (eapply functional_eval_exp; eassumption).
  assert (z1 = b3) by (eapply functional_eval_exp; eassumption).
  assert (u2 = b3) by (eapply functional_eval_exp; eassumption).
  subst.
  apply rel_chain_of_pair in Hx, Hy, Hz, Hu.
  assert (M1 : rel_chain per_level_sort ([b1; b2; b3; b4; x2]))
    by (merge_rel_chain Hbchain Hx b2).
  assert (M2 : rel_chain per_level_sort ([y1; b1; b2; b3; b4; x2]))
    by (merge_rel_chain M1 Hy b2).
  assert (M3 : rel_chain per_level_sort ([y1; b1; b2; b3; b4; x2; z2]))
    by (merge_rel_chain M2 Hz b3).
  assert (M4 : rel_chain per_level_sort ([u1; y1; b1; b2; b3; b4; x2; z2]))
    by (merge_rel_chain M3 Hu b3).
  split; [| split ].
  - exists b1, x2; split; [ eassumption | split; [ eassumption | pairwise ] ].
  - exists y1, z2; split; [ eassumption | split; [ eassumption | pairwise ] ].
  - exists u1, b4; split; [ eassumption | split; [ eassumption | pairwise ] ].
Qed.

Related types of levels, at some relation, from related elements of LevelSort.
Lemma per_level_code_of_level_sort : forall a a', Dom a ≈ a' ∈ per_level_sort -> exists R, per_level_code R a a'.
Proof.
  intros * (Hl & Hl' & [R HR]); exists R; exact (per_univ_elem_level_code _ _ _ _ HR Hl Hl').
Qed.

Related types of levels are related elements of LevelSort.
Lemma per_level_sort_of_code : forall R a a', per_level_code R a a' -> Dom a ≈ a' ∈ per_level_sort.
Proof.
  intros * H; split; [ exists R, a'; left; exact H | split; [ exists R, a; right; exact H |] ].
  exists R; exact (per_level_code_univ_elem _ _ _ H _).
Qed.

Building a Π between types of levels at per_pi, as per_univ_elem_pi_canonical does in a universe.
Lemma per_level_code_pi_canonical : forall {a a' in_rel ρ B ρ' B'},
    per_level_code in_rel a a' ->
    (forall c c', Dom c ≈ c' ∈ in_rel ->
       exists b b', ⟦ B ⟧ ρ ↦ c ⦂ entry_type_value a ↘ b /\ ⟦ B' ⟧ ρ' ↦ c' ⦂ entry_type_value a' ↘ b' /\
                    Dom b ≈ b' ∈ per_level_sort) ->
    per_level_code (per_pi a a' in_rel B ρ B' ρ') (Πₗᵈ a ρ B) (Πₗᵈ a' ρ' B').
Proof.
  intros * Ha HB.
  pose proof (per_level_code_univ_elem _ _ _ Ha 0) as Ha0.
  eapply (per_level_code_pi in_rel
            (fun c c' (_ : Dom c ≈ c' ∈ in_rel) =>
               per_head B B' (ρ ↦ c ⦂ entry_type_value a) (ρ' ↦ c' ⦂ entry_type_value a')));
    [ exact Ha | exact (per_elem_PER Ha0) | | reflexivity ].
  intros c c' Hc.
  destruct (HB _ _ Hc) as (b & b' & Eb & Eb' & Hbb').
  destruct (per_level_code_of_level_sort _ _ Hbb') as [R HR].
  econstructor; [ exact Eb | exact Eb' |].
  eapply per_level_code_resp_iff; [| exact HR ].
  exact (per_head_iff Eb Eb' (per_level_code_univ_elem _ _ _ HR 0)).
Qed.

The congruence of the Π between types of levels.
Lemma rel_exp_under_ctx_pi_level_cong : forall {Γ A A' B B'},
    Γ ⊨ A : LevelSort ->
    Γ ⊨ A ≈ A' : LevelSort ->
    Γ ▹{ak_level} A ⊨ B ≈ B' : LevelSort ->
    Γ ⊨ Πₗ A B ≈ Πₗ A' B' : LevelSort.
Proof.
  intros * HA0 HA HB.
  pose proof (rel_type_of_level_sort 0 HA0) as HAself.
  pose proof (rel_type_of_level_sort 0 HA) as HAt.
  pose proof (rel_type_inversion HAt) as [env_relΓ [HΓ HAgen]].
  pose proof (rel_exp_of_level_sort_inversion HA) as [env_relΓ2 [_ HAlv]].
  apply rel_exp_of_level_sort; exists env_relΓ, HΓ.
  intros Γ' env_rel' HΓ' σ σ' Hσj ρ ρ' ρσ ρ'σ' Hρ Hev Hev'.
  destruct (HAgen _ _ HΓ' _ _ Hσj _ _ _ _ Hρ Hev Hev') as [a1 a2 a3 a4 Ha1 Ha2 Ha3 Ha4 Hachain].
  destruct (HAlv _ _ HΓ' _ _ Hσj _ _ _ _ Hρ Hev Hev') as [e1 e2 e3 e4 He1 He2 He3 He4 Helv].
  functional_eval_rewrite_clear.
  functionalize_per_univ_chain Hachain in_rel.
  assert (Ha14 : DF a1 ≈ a4 ∈ per_univ_elem 0 ↘ in_rel) by pairwise.
The codomains at every related pair of arguments, along the three links.
  assert (Hq : forall c c', Dom c ≈ c' ∈ in_rel ->
             (exists b b', ⟦ B[q σ] ⟧ ρ ↦ c ⦂ entry_type_value a1 ↘ b /\ ⟦ B ⟧ ρσ ↦ c' ⦂ entry_type_value a2 ↘ b' /\
                           Dom b ≈ b' ∈ per_level_sort) /\
             (exists b b', ⟦ B ⟧ ρσ ↦ c ⦂ entry_type_value a2 ↘ b /\ ⟦ B' ⟧ ρ'σ' ↦ c' ⦂ entry_type_value a3 ↘ b' /\
                           Dom b ≈ b' ∈ per_level_sort) /\
             (exists b b', ⟦ B' ⟧ ρ'σ' ↦ c ⦂ entry_type_value a3 ↘ b /\ ⟦ B'[q σ'] ⟧ ρ' ↦ c' ⦂ entry_type_value a4 ↘ b' /\
                           Dom b ≈ b' ∈ per_level_sort)).
  { intros c c' Hc.
    pose proof (args_readable_of_chain Hachain Hc) as Hts.
    pose proof (entry_readable_of_elem Ha14 Hc) as [Hr1 Hr4].
    pose proof (per_env_extend_sub_intro HΓ' Hσj HAself _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hρ Ha1 Ha14 Hc Hr1 Hr4) as Hpair.
    exact (rel_exp_of_level_sort_under_ctx_q HΓ' Hσj HAself HB _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hpair Hts Hev Hev'). }
  
The domains are related types of levels at the domain's relation.
  assert (Hcode : forall x y, Dom x ≈ y ∈ per_level_sort -> DF x ≈ y ∈ per_univ_elem 0 ↘ in_rel ->
                    per_level_code in_rel x y)
    by (intros x y (Hl & Hl' & _) Hxy; exact (per_univ_elem_level_code _ _ _ _ Hxy Hl Hl')).
  assert (H12 : DF a1 ≈ a2 ∈ per_univ_elem 0 ↘ in_rel) by pairwise.
  assert (H23 : DF a2 ≈ a3 ∈ per_univ_elem 0 ↘ in_rel) by pairwise.
  assert (H34 : DF a3 ≈ a4 ∈ per_univ_elem 0 ↘ in_rel) by pairwise.
  assert (L12 : Dom a1 ≈ a2 ∈ per_level_sort) by pairwise.
  assert (L23 : Dom a2 ≈ a3 ∈ per_level_sort) by pairwise.
  assert (L34 : Dom a3 ≈ a4 ∈ per_level_sort) by pairwise.
  apply (mk_rel_exp Πₗᵈ a1 ρ B[q σ] Πₗᵈ a2 ρσ B Πₗᵈ a3 ρ'σ' B' Πₗᵈ a4 ρ' B'[q σ']);
    [ apply eval_exp_pi; exact Ha1 | apply eval_exp_pi; exact Ha2
    | apply eval_exp_pi; exact Ha3 | apply eval_exp_pi; exact Ha4 |].
  apply rel_chain_4; eapply per_level_sort_of_code; apply (per_level_code_pi_canonical (in_rel := in_rel)).
  - exact (Hcode _ _ L12 H12).
  - intros c c' Hc; exact (proj1 (Hq _ _ Hc)).
  - exact (Hcode _ _ L23 H23).
  - intros c c' Hc; exact (proj1 (proj2 (Hq _ _ Hc))).
  - exact (Hcode _ _ L34 H34).
  - intros c c' Hc; exact (proj2 (proj2 (Hq _ _ Hc))).
Qed.

End Fixed_GCtx.

A Π out of a domain of the kind κd into a codomain of the kind κc (pi_kinds), at a universe U (wf_exp_eq_pi_cong): at ak_relevant a type of U, large or small at a level term; at ak_propositional the ∀, a proposition; at ak_level a Π between types of levels, a type of levels.
Lemma sem_exp_eq_pi_cong :
  `( Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊨ᵤ U ->
     Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊨ A : abs_kind_sort κd U ->
     Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊨ A ≈ A' : abs_kind_sort κd U ->
     Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ▹{κd} A ⊨ B ≈ B' : (abs_kind_sort κc U)[↑]ʷ ->
     pi_kinds κd κc ->
     Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊨ a_pi κd κc A B ≈ a_pi κd κc A' B' : abs_kind_sort κc U ).
Proof.
  intros * HU HA0 HA HB Hk; sem_intro; [ assumption |].
  destruct Hk as [κd | κd |]; cbn [abs_kind_sort exp_wk] in *.
  - destruct HU as [[? ->] | (? & ? & -> & ?)]; cbn [exp_wk] in *.
    + eapply rel_exp_under_ctx_pi_cong;
        [ exact (rel_type_of_abs_kind_sort HA0) | exact (rel_type_of_abs_kind_sort HA)
        | intros R HR ρ ρ' Hρ; exact (rel_exp_of_abs_kind_sort_at HR HA0 _ _ Hρ) | exact HB ].
    + eapply rel_exp_under_ctx_pi_cong_small; eassumption.
  - destruct HU as [[? ->] | (? & ? & -> & ?)].
    + eapply rel_exp_under_ctx_all; [ exact (rel_type_of_abs_kind_sort HA0) | exact (rel_type_of_abs_kind_sort HA) | exact HB ].
    + eapply rel_exp_under_ctx_all;
        [ exact (rel_type_of_domain_suniv HA0) | exact (rel_type_of_domain_suniv HA) | exact HB ].
  - exact (rel_exp_under_ctx_pi_level_cong HA0 HA HB).
Qed.

Lemma sem_pi :
  `( Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊨ᵤ U ->
     Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊨ A : abs_kind_sort κd U ->
     Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ▹{κd} A ⊨ B : (abs_kind_sort κc U)[↑]ʷ ->
     pi_kinds κd κc ->
     Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊨ a_pi κd κc A B : abs_kind_sort κc U ).
Proof. intros * HU HA HB Hk; eapply sem_exp_eq_pi_cong; eassumption. Qed.

Section Fixed_GCtx.
  Context {GC : GCtx}.

λ-Congruence

A λ evaluates to a closure over its domain's value with no other premise (eval_exp_fn), so all four values of the goal are known up front. Each link of the chain applies two closures, which take arguments of their domains' sorts, and eval_app_fn turns the application into evaluating the two bodies in the two extended environments. These are the three obligations of rel_exp_under_ctx_q, and they land in the per_head that per_pi asks for.
Lemma rel_exp_under_ctx_fn_cong : forall {Γ κd A A'} {i : nat} {B M M'},
    Γ ⊨ᵗ A ≈ A at i ->
    Γ ⊨ᵗ A ≈ A' at i ->
    rel_type_kind Γ A κd ->
    Γ ▹{κd} A ⊨ B : Typeω@i ->
    Γ ▹{κd} A ⊨ M ≈ M' : B ->
    Γ ⊨ λ A M ≈ λ A' M' : Π{κd} A B.
Proof.
  intros * HAself HA HAk HB HM.
  pose proof (rel_type_inversion HA) as [env_relΓ [HΓ HAgen]].
  assert (HBrel : forall ρ ρ' R, EF Γ ▹{κd} A ≈ Γ ▹{κd} A ∈ per_ctx_env ↘ R -> Dom ρ ≈ ρ' ∈ R -> rel_typ_evaluated B ρ)
    by (intros * HR Hρ; exact (rel_exp_of_typ_evaluated_at HR HB _ _ Hρ)).
  eexists_rel_exp_with i.
  intros Γ' env_rel' HΓ' σ σ' Hσj ρ ρ' ρσ ρ'σ' Hρ Hev Hev'.
  destruct (rel_typ_of_pi HAself HAself HAk HB _ _ HΓ' _ _ _ _ _ _ Hσj Hρ Hev Hev')
    as [in_rel [a1 [a2 [a3 [a4 [Ha1 [Ha2 [Ha3 [Ha4 [Houter [Hmid Htyp]]]]]]]]]]].
  exists (per_pi a2 a3 in_rel B ρσ B ρ'σ').
  split; [ exact Htyp |]; right.
The right closures keep the values of A'; all four domains are of one sort.
  destruct (HAgen _ _ HΓ' _ _ Hσj _ _ _ _ Hρ Hev Hev') as [b1 b2 b3 b4 Hb1 Hb2 Hb3 Hb4 Hbc].
  functional_eval_rewrite_clear.
The chain of the domains of the four closures, at the domain PER.
  assert (H12 : Dom a1 ≈ a2 ∈ per_univ i) by pairwise.
  destruct H12 as [R12 H12].
  assert (H21 : DF a2 ≈ a1 ∈ per_univ_elem i ↘ R12) by (symmetry; exact H12).
  assert (H41 : DF a4 ≈ a1 ∈ per_univ_elem i ↘ in_rel) by (symmetry; exact Houter).
  assert (E12 : R12 <~> in_rel) by exact (per_univ_elem_left_irrel _ _ _ _ _ _ _ H21 H41).
  assert (Hbc' : rel_chain (per_univ_elem i in_rel) ([a1; a2; b3; b4]))
    by (eapply per_univ_chain_at_in; [ exact Hbc | | | exact (per_univ_elem_resp_iff H12 E12) ]; solve_in).
  assert (H1b4 : DF a1 ≈ b4 ∈ per_univ_elem i ↘ in_rel) by pairwise.
  assert (H2b3 : DF a2 ≈ b3 ∈ per_univ_elem i ↘ in_rel) by pairwise.
  pose proof (per_univ_elem_kind _ _ _ _ (per_univ_elem_resp_iff H12 E12)) as Er12.
  pose proof (per_univ_elem_kind _ _ _ _ H2b3) as Er23.
  assert (H34 : DF b3 ≈ b4 ∈ per_univ_elem i ↘ in_rel) by pairwise.
  pose proof (per_univ_elem_kind _ _ _ _ H34) as Er34.
  pose proof (per_univ_elem_kind _ _ _ _ Hmid) as Er23'.
The tails, related along σ ≈ σ'.
  assert (PER env_relΓ) by (eapply per_env_PER; eassumption).
  assert (Hρσ : Dom ρσ ≈ ρ'σ' ∈ env_relΓ) by (eapply rel_sub_under_ctx_at'; eassumption).
The codomain's head PER, read at the right closure's domain value b3 of A', is the one per_pi names, at the type's domain value a3 of A: the two extensions are related.
  assert (Hmove : forall c c', Dom c ≈ c' ∈ in_rel ->
             per_head B B (ρσ ↦ c ⦂ entry_type_value a2) (ρ'σ' ↦ c' ⦂ entry_type_value b3) <~>
             per_head B B (ρσ ↦ c ⦂ entry_type_value a2) (ρ'σ' ↦ c' ⦂ entry_type_value a3)).
  { intros c c' Hc.
    pose proof (entry_readable_of_elem Hmid Hc) as [Hr2 Hr3].
    pose proof (entry_readable_of_elem H2b3 Hc) as [_ Hr3b].
    exact (per_head_codomain_resp HΓ HAself (rel_type_of_typ HB) _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _
             Hρσ Ha2 Ha3 Hmid Hc Hc Hc Hr2 Hr3b Hr2 Hr3). }
  apply (mk_rel_exp λᵈ a1 ρ M[q σ] λᵈ a2 ρσ M λᵈ b3 ρ'σ' M' λᵈ b4 ρ' M'[q σ']);
    [ apply eval_exp_fn; exact Ha1 | apply eval_exp_fn; exact Ha2 | apply eval_exp_fn; exact Hb3 | apply eval_exp_fn; exact Hb4 |].
  apply rel_chain_4; (constructor; [ cbn; congruence | cbn; congruence |]); intros c c' Hc;
    pose proof (args_readable_of_chain Hbc' Hc) as Hts;
    pose proof (entry_readable_of_elem H1b4 Hc) as [Hr1 Hr4];
    pose proof (per_env_extend_sub_intro HΓ' Hσj HAself _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hρ Ha1 H1b4 Hc Hr1 Hr4)
      as Hpair;
    destruct (rel_exp_under_ctx_q HΓ' Hσj HAself HM HBrel _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hpair Hts Hev Hev')
      as [[m1 [m2 [Hm1 [Hm2 Hm]]]]
[[n1 [n2 [Hn1 [Hn2 Hn]]]] [p1 [p2 [Hp1 [Hp2 Hp]]]]]].
  - econstructor; [ apply eval_app_fn; exact Hm1 | apply eval_app_fn; exact Hm2 | apply (Hmove _ _ Hc); exact Hm ].
  - econstructor; [ apply eval_app_fn; exact Hn1 | apply eval_app_fn; exact Hn2 | apply (Hmove _ _ Hc); exact Hn ].
  - econstructor; [ apply eval_app_fn; exact Hp1 | apply eval_app_fn; exact Hp2 | apply (Hmove _ _ Hc); exact Hp ].
Qed.

Hint Resolve rel_exp_under_ctx_fn_cong : mctt.

λ-congruence into a type of an evaluated kind κc, a type of a universe or a type of levels, as rel_exp_under_ctx_fn_cong is for a codomain in a universe: generalizing a member of a type of levels over the parameters of a unit reads such λs.
Lemma rel_exp_under_ctx_fn_cong_evaluated : forall {Γ κd κc A A'} {i : nat} {B M M'},
    Γ ⊨ᵗ A ≈ A at i ->
    Γ ⊨ᵗ A ≈ A' at i ->
    rel_type_kind Γ A κd ->
    Γ ▹{κd} A ⊨ᵗ B ≈ B at i ->
    rel_type_kind (Γ ▹{κd} A) B κc ->
    pi_kinds κd κc -> evaluated_kind κc ->
    Γ ▹{κd} A ⊨ M ≈ M' : B ->
    Γ ⊨ λ A M ≈ λ A' M' : a_pi κd κc A B.
Proof.
  intros * HAself HA HAk HB HBr Hk Hev0 HM.
  pose proof (rel_type_inversion HA) as [env_relΓ [HΓ HAgen]].
  assert (HBrel : forall ρ ρ' R, EF Γ ▹{κd} A ≈ Γ ▹{κd} A ∈ per_ctx_env ↘ R -> Dom ρ ≈ ρ' ∈ R -> rel_typ_evaluated B ρ)
    by (intros * HR Hρ; exact (rel_typ_evaluated_of_kind (HBr _ HR _ _ Hρ) Hev0)).
  eexists_rel_exp_with i.
  intros Γ' env_rel' HΓ' σ σ' Hσj ρ ρ' ρσ ρ'σ' Hρ Hev Hev'.
  destruct (rel_typ_of_pi_evaluated HAself HAself HAk HB HBr Hk Hev0 _ _ HΓ' _ _ _ _ _ _ Hσj Hρ Hev Hev')
    as [in_rel [a1 [a2 [a3 [a4 [Ha1 [Ha2 [Ha3 [Ha4 [Houter [Hmid Htyp]]]]]]]]]]].
  exists (per_pi a2 a3 in_rel B ρσ B ρ'σ').
  split; [ exact Htyp |]; right.
  destruct (HAgen _ _ HΓ' _ _ Hσj _ _ _ _ Hρ Hev Hev') as [b1 b2 b3 b4 Hb1 Hb2 Hb3 Hb4 Hbc].
  functional_eval_rewrite_clear.
  assert (H12 : Dom a1 ≈ a2 ∈ per_univ i) by pairwise.
  destruct H12 as [R12 H12].
  assert (H21 : DF a2 ≈ a1 ∈ per_univ_elem i ↘ R12) by (symmetry; exact H12).
  assert (H41 : DF a4 ≈ a1 ∈ per_univ_elem i ↘ in_rel) by (symmetry; exact Houter).
  assert (E12 : R12 <~> in_rel) by exact (per_univ_elem_left_irrel _ _ _ _ _ _ _ H21 H41).
  assert (Hbc' : rel_chain (per_univ_elem i in_rel) ([a1; a2; b3; b4]))
    by (eapply per_univ_chain_at_in; [ exact Hbc | | | exact (per_univ_elem_resp_iff H12 E12) ]; solve_in).
  assert (H1b4 : DF a1 ≈ b4 ∈ per_univ_elem i ↘ in_rel) by pairwise.
  assert (H2b3 : DF a2 ≈ b3 ∈ per_univ_elem i ↘ in_rel) by pairwise.
  pose proof (per_univ_elem_kind _ _ _ _ (per_univ_elem_resp_iff H12 E12)) as Er12.
  pose proof (per_univ_elem_kind _ _ _ _ H2b3) as Er23.
  assert (H34 : DF b3 ≈ b4 ∈ per_univ_elem i ↘ in_rel) by pairwise.
  pose proof (per_univ_elem_kind _ _ _ _ H34) as Er34.
  pose proof (per_univ_elem_kind _ _ _ _ Hmid) as Er23'.
  assert (PER env_relΓ) by (eapply per_env_PER; eassumption).
  assert (Hρσ : Dom ρσ ≈ ρ'σ' ∈ env_relΓ) by (eapply rel_sub_under_ctx_at'; eassumption).
  assert (Hmove : forall c c', Dom c ≈ c' ∈ in_rel ->
             per_head B B (ρσ ↦ c ⦂ entry_type_value a2) (ρ'σ' ↦ c' ⦂ entry_type_value b3) <~>
             per_head B B (ρσ ↦ c ⦂ entry_type_value a2) (ρ'σ' ↦ c' ⦂ entry_type_value a3)).
  { intros c c' Hc.
    pose proof (entry_readable_of_elem Hmid Hc) as [Hr2 Hr3].
    pose proof (entry_readable_of_elem H2b3 Hc) as [_ Hr3b].
    exact (per_head_codomain_resp HΓ HAself HB _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _
             Hρσ Ha2 Ha3 Hmid Hc Hc Hc Hr2 Hr3b Hr2 Hr3). }
  apply (mk_rel_exp λᵈ a1 ρ M[q σ] λᵈ a2 ρσ M λᵈ b3 ρ'σ' M' λᵈ b4 ρ' M'[q σ']);
    [ apply eval_exp_fn; exact Ha1 | apply eval_exp_fn; exact Ha2 | apply eval_exp_fn; exact Hb3 | apply eval_exp_fn; exact Hb4 |].
  apply rel_chain_4; (constructor; [ cbn; congruence | cbn; congruence |]); intros c c' Hc;
    pose proof (args_readable_of_chain Hbc' Hc) as Hts;
    pose proof (entry_readable_of_elem H1b4 Hc) as [Hr1 Hr4];
    pose proof (per_env_extend_sub_intro HΓ' Hσj HAself _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hρ Ha1 H1b4 Hc Hr1 Hr4)
      as Hpair;
    destruct (rel_exp_under_ctx_q HΓ' Hσj HAself HM HBrel _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hpair Hts Hev Hev')
      as [[m1 [m2 [Hm1 [Hm2 Hm]]]]
[[n1 [n2 [Hn1 [Hn2 Hn]]]] [p1 [p2 [Hp1 [Hp2 Hp]]]]]].
  - econstructor; [ apply eval_app_fn; exact Hm1 | apply eval_app_fn; exact Hm2 | apply (Hmove _ _ Hc); exact Hm ].
  - econstructor; [ apply eval_app_fn; exact Hn1 | apply eval_app_fn; exact Hn2 | apply (Hmove _ _ Hc); exact Hn ].
  - econstructor; [ apply eval_app_fn; exact Hp1 | apply eval_app_fn; exact Hp2 | apply (Hmove _ _ Hc); exact Hp ].
Qed.

The domain and the codomain of a Π the rules of λ and of application name, at one index: the domain's from its sort, lifted, and the codomain's index, lifted, at a relevant Π; at a ∀ the ∀ itself, a proposition.
Lemma rel_pi_parts : forall {Γ κ A A' Srt B} {i : nat},
    type_sort Srt ->
    Γ ⊨ A : Srt ->
    Γ ⊨ A ≈ A' : Srt ->
    Γ ▹{κ} A ⊨ B : Typeω@i ->
    exists k, Γ ⊨ᵗ A ≈ A at k /\ Γ ⊨ᵗ A ≈ A' at k /\ Γ ▹{κ} A ⊨ B : Typeω@k.
Proof.
  intros * HS HA0 HA HB.
  destruct (rel_type_of_sort_ge HS HA0) as [k0 Hk0].
  destruct (rel_type_of_sort_ge HS HA) as [k1 Hk1].
  exists (Nat.max i (Nat.max k0 k1)); split; [| split ].
  - apply Hk0; lia.
  - apply Hk1; lia.
  - eapply rel_exp_cumu_ge; [| exact HB ]; lia.
Qed.

Lemma rel_all_of_parts : forall {Γ κd A A' Srt B B'},
    type_sort Srt ->
    Γ ⊨ A : Srt ->
    Γ ⊨ A ≈ A' : Srt ->
    Γ ▹{κd} A ⊨ B ≈ B' : Propₘ ->
    Γ ⊨ ∀ₚ{κd} A B ≈ ∀ₚ{κd} A' B' : Propₘ.
Proof.
  intros * HS HA0 HA HB.
  destruct (rel_type_of_sort_ge HS HA0) as [k0 Hk0].
  destruct (rel_type_of_sort_ge HS HA) as [k1 Hk1].
  eapply rel_exp_under_ctx_all; [ apply (Hk0 (Nat.max k0 k1)); lia | apply (Hk1 (Nat.max k0 k1)); lia | exact HB ].
Qed.

A type of a sort is of the sort's kind (sort_kind).
Lemma rel_type_kind_of_sort_kind : forall {Γ A Srt κ},
    sort_kind Srt κ -> Γ ⊨ A : Srt -> rel_type_kind Γ A κ.
Proof.
  intros * HS HA R HR ρ ρ' Hρ.
  destruct (sort_kind_abs_kind_sort_inv _ _ HS) as [i ->].
  exact (rel_exp_of_abs_kind_sort_at HR HA _ _ Hρ).
Qed.

End Fixed_GCtx.

A λ over a domain of the kind κd into a codomain of the kind κc (pi_kinds, wf_exp_eq_fn_cong): a function into a type of a universe, a function between types of levels, or a proof of a ∀.
Lemma sem_exp_eq_fn_cong :
  `( Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊨ A : Srt ->
     sort_kind Srt κd ->
     Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊨ A ≈ A' : Srt ->
     Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ▹{κd} A ⊨ B : abs_kind_sort κc Typeω@i ->
     pi_kinds κd κc ->
     Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ▹{κd} A ⊨ M ≈ M' : B ->
     Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊨ λ A M ≈ λ A' M' : a_pi κd κc A B ).
Proof.
  intros * HA0 HS HA HB Hk HM; sem_intro; [ assumption |].
  pose proof (sort_kind_type_sort _ _ HS) as HSt.
  pose proof (rel_type_kind_of_sort_kind HS HA0) as HAk.
  destruct Hk as [κd | κd |]; cbn [abs_kind_sort] in *.
  - destruct (rel_pi_parts HSt HA0 HA HB) as [k [Hl [Hr Hk]]].
    exact (rel_exp_under_ctx_fn_cong Hl Hr HAk Hk HM).
  - exact (rel_exp_under_ctx_proof (rel_all_of_parts HSt HA0 HA0 HB)).
  - inversion HS; subst.
    exact (rel_exp_under_ctx_fn_cong_evaluated (rel_type_of_level_sort 0 HA0) (rel_type_of_level_sort 0 HA) HAk
             (rel_type_of_level_sort 0 HB) (rel_type_kind_of_level_sort HB) pi_kinds_level evaluated_kind_level HM).
Qed.

Lemma sem_fn :
  `( Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊨ A : Srt ->
     sort_kind Srt κd ->
     Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ▹{κd} A ⊨ B : abs_kind_sort κc Typeω@i ->
     pi_kinds κd κc ->
     Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ▹{κd} A ⊨ M : B ->
     Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊨ λ A M : a_pi κd κc A B ).
Proof. intros * HA HS HB Hk HM; eapply sem_exp_eq_fn_cong; eassumption. Qed.

Section Fixed_GCtx.
  Context {GC : GCtx}.

Application Congruence

The type of this rule is an instantiated codomain rather than a Π. At a relevant domain, everything the type B[Id,,N] costs is done once in rel_typ_of_instance, which also serves β; what is left here is the term side. The element PER is the head PER of B at the arguments the type names, ⟦N⟧ρσ and ⟦N⟧ρ'σ'. Each link of M's chain arrives in the head PER of its own pair of arguments, and per_head_codomain_resp moves it.
Lemma rel_exp_under_ctx_app_cong : forall {Γ κd κc A} {i j : nat} {B M M' N N'},
    Γ ⊨ᵗ A ≈ A at j ->
    rel_type_kind Γ A κd ->
    evaluated_kind κd ->
    evaluated_kind κc ->
    Γ ▹{κd} A ⊨ᵗ B ≈ B at i ->
    Γ ⊨ M ≈ M' : a_pi κd κc A B ->
    Γ ⊨ N ≈ N' : A ->
    exp_scoped (List.length Γ) N ->
    Γ ⊨ M $ N ≈ M' $ N' : B[Id ,, N].
Proof.
  intros * HA HAk HAe Hκc HB HM HN HNs.
  assert (HArel : rel_type_evaluated Γ A) by (exists κd; split; assumption).
The type mentions N on both sides, so the type judgment is built from the reflexive-left form of HN; HN itself is used only for the term chain.
  pose proof (rel_exp_under_ctx_refl_left HN) as HNl.
  pose proof (rel_type_inversion HA) as [env_relΓ [HΓ _]].
  destruct HM as [? ? k HMgen].
  destruct HN as [? ? l HNgen].
  eexists_rel_exp_with i.
  intros Γ' env_rel' HΓ' σ σ' Hσj ρ ρ' ρσ ρ'σ' Hρ Hev Hev'.
  destruct (rel_typ_of_instance HA HArel HB HNl HNs _ _ HΓ' _ _ _ _ _ _ Hσj Hρ Hev Hev')
    as [l' [RN [a1 [a2 [a3 [a4 [p1 [p2 [p3 [p4 [Ha1 [Ha2 [Ha3 [Ha4 [Houter
       [Hmid [Hp1 [Hp2 [Hp3 [Hp4 [Hpchain [_ Htyp]]]]]]]]]]]]]]]]]]]]]].
  exists (per_head B B (ρσ ↦ p2 ⦂ centry_tag (ce_ass κd A) Γ ρσ) (ρ'σ' ↦ p3 ⦂ centry_tag (ce_ass κd A) Γ ρ'σ')).
  split; [ exact Htyp |]; right.
  assert (Hρσ : Dom ρσ ≈ ρ'σ' ∈ env_relΓ)
    by (eapply (rel_sub_under_ctx_at' Hσj HΓ' HΓ); eassumption).
The domain is of the evaluated kind κd.
  destruct (HAk _ HΓ _ _ Hρσ) as (a2' & Ha2' & Er2k).
  assert (a2' = a2) as -> by (eapply functional_eval_exp; eassumption).
  assert (Er2 : evaluated_kind (domain_kind a2)) by (rewrite Er2k; exact HAe).

The Argument

The other instantiation of N's judgment, for N ≈ N', identified with the reflexive one. Both agree on the values of A, so retype_rel_chain puts both chains in one PER, and they merge.
  destruct (HNgen _ _ HΓ' _ _ Hσj _ _ _ _ Hρ Hev Hev') as [RN2 [HNtyp HNexp]].
  apply (rel_exp_or_prop_evaluated HNtyp (ex_intro _ a2 (conj Ha2 Er2))) in HNexp.
  destruct HNtyp as [b1 b2 b3 b4 Hb1 Hb2 Hb3 Hb4 Hbchain].
  destruct HNexp as [n1 n2 n3 n4 Hn1 Hn2 Hn3 Hn4 Hnchain].
  assert (b2 = a2) as -> by (eapply functional_eval_exp; [ exact Hb2 | exact Ha2 ]).
  assert (b3 = a3) as -> by (eapply functional_eval_exp; [ exact Hb3 | exact Ha3 ]).
  retype_rel_chain Hbchain Hmid Hnchain.
  assert (Hp1n1 : p1 = n1) by (eapply functional_eval_exp; [ exact Hp1 | exact Hn1 ]).
  assert (Hp2n2 : p2 = n2) by (eapply functional_eval_exp; [ exact Hp2 | exact Hn2 ]).
  subst p1 p2.
  assert (Hnall : rel_chain RN ([n1; n2; n3; n4; p3; p4]))
    by (merge_rel_chain Hnchain Hpchain n1).

The Function

The middle link of its type chain is a Π of the values of A and the syntactic B, which identifies its element PER with the canonical per_pi. Each link of its term chain is then a function of an argument pair.
  destruct (HMgen _ _ HΓ' _ _ Hσj _ _ _ _ Hρ Hev Hev') as [RM [HMtyp HMexp]].
  assert (HΠr : rel_typ_evaluated (a_pi κd κc A B) ρσ)
    by (exists (d_pi κd κc a2 ρσ B); split; [ apply eval_exp_pi; exact Ha2 | exact Hκc ]).
  apply (rel_exp_or_prop_evaluated HMtyp HΠr) in HMexp.
  destruct HMtyp as [c1 c2 c3 c4 Hc1 Hc2 Hc3 Hc4 Hcchain].
  destruct HMexp as [m1 m2 m3 m4 Hm1 Hm2 Hm3 Hm4 Hmchain].
  assert (c2 = d_pi κd κc a2 ρσ B) as ->
    by (eapply functional_eval_exp; [ exact Hc2 | apply eval_exp_pi; exact Ha2 ]).
  assert (c3 = d_pi κd κc a3 ρ'σ' B) as ->
    by (eapply functional_eval_exp; [ exact Hc3 | apply eval_exp_pi; exact Ha3 ]).
  assert (HRMmid : DF d_pi κd κc a2 ρσ B ≈ d_pi κd κc a3 ρ'σ' B ∈ per_univ_elem k ↘ RM) by pairwise.
  rewrite (per_pi_iff Hκc Hmid HRMmid) in Hmchain.

The Term Chain

Three applications, at the three consecutive argument pairs. The middle value of each link is the first value of the next, so the three rel_mod_apps form one chain.
  assert (Hn12 : Dom n1 ≈ n2 ∈ RN) by pairwise.
  assert (Hn23 : Dom n2 ≈ n3 ∈ RN) by pairwise.
  assert (Hn34 : Dom n3 ≈ n4 ∈ RN) by pairwise.
  assert (Hn2p3 : Dom n2 ≈ p3 ∈ RN) by pairwise.
  assert (Hn22 : Dom n2 ≈ n2 ∈ RN) by pairwise.
  assert (Hn24 : Dom n2 ≈ n4 ∈ RN) by pairwise.
  destruct Hmchain as (Hpi1 & Hpi2 & Hpi3).
  pose proof (per_univ_elem_kind _ _ _ _ Hmid) as Er23.
  destruct (pi_elements_app _ _ _ _ _ _ Hpi1 _ _ Hn12) as [r1 r2 Hr1 Hr2 Hr].
  destruct (pi_elements_app _ _ _ _ _ _ Hpi2 _ _ Hn23) as [s1 s2 Hs1 Hs2 Hs].
  destruct (pi_elements_app _ _ _ _ _ _ Hpi3 _ _ Hn34) as [u1 u2 Hu1 Hu2 Hu].
  assert (Hs1e : s1 = r2) by (eapply functional_eval_app; [ exact Hs1 | exact Hr2 ]).
  assert (Hu1e : u1 = s2) by (eapply functional_eval_app; [ exact Hu1 | exact Hs2 ]).
  subst s1 u1.
The functions take arguments of the evaluated kind κd.
  assert (Ef1 : evaluated_kind (arg_kind gc_deps gc_stack m1))
    by (rewrite (pi_elements_left _ _ _ _ _ _ Hpi1); exact Er2).
  assert (Ef2 : evaluated_kind (arg_kind gc_deps gc_stack m2))
    by (rewrite (pi_elements_right _ _ _ _ _ _ Hpi1), <- Er23; exact Er2).
  assert (Ef3 : evaluated_kind (arg_kind gc_deps gc_stack m3))
    by (rewrite (pi_elements_right _ _ _ _ _ _ Hpi2), <- Er23; exact Er2).
  assert (Ef4 : evaluated_kind (arg_kind gc_deps gc_stack m4))
    by (rewrite (pi_elements_right _ _ _ _ _ _ Hpi3), <- Er23; exact Er2).
  apply (mk_rel_exp r1 r2 s2 u2);
    [ eapply eval_exp_app; [ exact Hm1 | exact Ef1 | exact Hn1 | exact Hr1 ]
    | eapply eval_exp_app; [ exact Hm2 | exact Ef2 | exact Hn2 | exact Hr2 ]
    | eapply eval_exp_app; [ exact Hm3 | exact Ef3 | exact Hn3 | exact Hs2 ]
    | eapply eval_exp_app; [ exact Hm4 | exact Ef4 | exact Hn4 | exact Hu2 ]
    |].
Each link arrives in the head PER of its own argument pair, at the tags of the type's domain values; per_head_codomain_resp moves it to the instance's.
  pose proof (per_ctx_env_of_typ (κ := κd) HΓ HA) as HΓA0.
  destruct (per_head_closure_readable HΓA0 HΓ Hρσ (per_head_of Ha2 Ha3 Hmid Hn2p3)) as [Rn2 Rp3].
  assert (Hmove : forall x y, Dom x ≈ y ∈ RN -> Dom n2 ≈ y ∈ RN ->
             per_head B B (ρσ ↦ x ⦂ entry_type_value a2) (ρ'σ' ↦ y ⦂ entry_type_value a3) <~>
             per_head B B (ρσ ↦ n2 ⦂ centry_tag (ce_ass κd A) Γ ρσ) (ρ'σ' ↦ p3 ⦂ centry_tag (ce_ass κd A) Γ ρ'σ')).
  { intros x y Hxy Huy.
    pose proof (entry_readable_of_elem Hmid Hxy) as [Rx Ry].
    exact (per_head_codomain_resp HΓ HA HB _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _
             Hρσ Ha2 Ha3 Hmid Hxy Hn2p3 Huy Rx Ry Rn2 Rp3). }
  apply rel_chain_4;
    [ apply (Hmove _ _ Hn12 Hn22); exact Hr
    | apply (Hmove _ _ Hn23 Hn23); exact Hs
    | apply (Hmove _ _ Hn34 Hn24); exact Hu ].
Qed.

Hint Resolve rel_exp_under_ctx_app_cong : mctt.

A head whose type's value in the tail is a proposition is a proposition.
Lemma head_propositional_of_value : forall {Γ κ A ρ a},
    ⟦ A ⟧ ρ ↘ a ->
    domain_kind a = ak_propositional ->
    head_propositional gc_deps gc_stack (ce_ass κ A) Γ ρ.
Proof. intros * Ha Hr; econstructor; [ reflexivity | intros y _; reflexivity | exact Ha | exact Hr ]. Qed.

The Type Judgment of an Instantiation at a Proposition

rel_typ_of_instance for a domain that is a proposition: the argument is a proof, kept unevaluated, so every instantiating environment holds a kept proof at the head (eval_sub_extend_proof): ⋆ᵈ⟨N[σ], ρ⟩ along σ ,, N[σ], and ⋆ᵈ⟨N, ρσ⟩ along Id ,, N at the substituted environments. Any two readable proofs are related at the head of a proposition (per_head_proof), and they read back as N is scoped. The shape is that of rel_typ_of_instance: two instantiations and the bridge between them, at the pair of kept proofs crossing from one to the other. The element PER is the head PER of B at the kept proofs of the second instantiation.
Lemma rel_typ_of_instance_prop : forall {Γ A} {i : nat} {B N},
    Γ ⊨ A : Propₘ ->
    Γ ▹{ak_propositional} A ⊨ B ≈ B : Typeω@i ->
    Γ ⊨ N ≈ N : A ->
    exp_scoped (List.length Γ) N ->
    forall Γ' env_rel',
      EF Γ' ≈ Γ' ∈ per_ctx_env ↘ env_rel' ->
      forall σ σ' ρ ρ' ρσ ρ'σ',
        Γ' ⊨ˢ σ ≈ σ' : Γ ->
        Dom ρ ≈ ρ' ∈ env_rel' ->
        ⟦ σ : Γ ⟧s ρ ↘ ρσ ->
        ⟦ σ' : Γ ⟧s ρ' ↘ ρ'σ' ->
        exists a1 a2 a3 a4,
          ⟦ A[σ] ⟧ ρ ↘ a1 /\
          ⟦ A ⟧ ρσ ↘ a2 /\
          ⟦ A ⟧ ρ'σ' ↘ a3 /\
          ⟦ A[σ'] ⟧ ρ' ↘ a4 /\
          rel_chain per_prop ([a1; a2; a3; a4]) /\
          Definitions.rel_typ i B[Id,,N] σ ρ ρσ B[Id,,N] σ' ρ' ρ'σ'
            (per_head B B (ρσ ↦ ⋆ᵈ⟨N, ρσ⟩ ⦂ centry_tag (ce_ass ak_propositional A) Γ ρσ) (ρ'σ' ↦ ⋆ᵈ⟨N, ρ'σ'⟩ ⦂ centry_tag (ce_ass ak_propositional A) Γ ρ'σ')).
Proof.
  intros * HA HB HN HNs * HΓ' * Hσj Hρ Hev Hev'.
  pose proof (rel_exp_of_prop_inversion HA) as [env_relΓ [HΓ HAgen]].
  pose proof (rel_exp_of_typ_inversion HB) as [env_relΓA [HΓA HBgen]].
  pose proof (rel_exp_of_prop_not_level_sort HA) as HAn.
  pose proof (rel_sub_under_ctx_extend_sub (κ := ak_propositional) (rel_sub_id (ex_intro _ _ HΓ)) HN HAn HNs HNs) as HidN.
  rewrite exp_sub_id in HidN.
  assert (Hρσ : Dom ρσ ≈ ρ'σ' ∈ env_relΓ)
    by (eapply (rel_sub_under_ctx_at' Hσj HΓ' HΓ); eassumption).
  destruct (HAgen _ _ HΓ' _ _ Hσj _ _ _ _ Hρ Hev Hev') as [a1 a2 a3 a4 Ha1 Ha2 Ha3 Ha4 Hachain].
  pose proof Hachain as (_ & [Hr2 Hr3 _] & _).
  pose proof (head_propositional_of_value (Γ := Γ) (κ := ak_propositional) Ha2 Hr2) as Hp2.
  pose proof (head_propositional_of_value (Γ := Γ) (κ := ak_propositional) Ha3 Hr3) as Hp3.

The Kept Proofs

N is scoped by Γ, and N[σ], N[σ'] by Γ', so the kept proofs read back.
  pose proof Hσj as [? _ ? _ _ Hσs].
  assert (HNσ : exp_scoped (List.length Γ') N[σ])
    by (eapply exp_scoped_sub; [ exact HNs | intros x Hx; exact (proj1 (Hσs x Hx)) ]).
  destruct (per_ctx_env_kept_proof_readable _ _ _ N[σ] HΓ' (exp_scoped_free_bound _ _ HNσ) _ _ Hρ) as [Rp1 _].
  destruct (per_ctx_env_kept_proof_readable _ _ _ N HΓ (exp_scoped_free_bound _ _ HNs) _ _ Hρσ) as [Rp2 Rp3].

The Two Instantiations

The first along σ ,, N[σ], its outer values rewritten into the goal's spelling.
  destruct (HBgen _ _ HΓ' _ _ (rel_sub_under_ctx_extend_sub Hσj HN HAn HNs HNs) _ _ _ _ Hρ
                  (eval_sub_extend_proof _ _ _ _ _ _ Hev Hp2)
                  (eval_sub_extend_proof _ _ _ _ _ _ Hev' Hp3))
    as [t1 tA2 tA3 t4 Ht1 HtA2 HtA3 Ht4 HtAchain].
  apply rel_chain_relevant_univ in HtAchain.
  rewrite <- exp_sub_extend_sub in Ht1, Ht4.
The second along Id,,N, whose results are the extensions of the restamped environments; read at the extensions of the environments themselves (rel_type_body_of_retagged).
  destruct (rel_exp_of_prop_inversion_simple_at HΓ HA _ _ (per_ctx_env_retag HΓ _ _ Hρσ))
    as (a2r & a3r & Ha2r & Ha3r & [Hl2r Hr3r _]).
  pose proof (head_propositional_of_value (Γ := Γ) (κ := ak_propositional) Ha2r Hl2r) as Hp2r.
  pose proof (head_propositional_of_value (Γ := Γ) (κ := ak_propositional) Ha3r Hr3r) as Hp3r.
  destruct (eval_sub_id_rel HΓ Hρσ) as [Hid2 Hid3].
  pose proof (per_ctx_env_of_typ (κ := ak_propositional) HΓ (rel_type_of_prop 0 HA)) as HΓA0.
  assert (EA : env_relΓA <~> per_env_extend A A env_relΓ) by (eapply per_ctx_env_right_irrel; eassumption).
  assert (Hext : Dom ρσ ↦ ⋆ᵈ⟨N, ρσ⟩ ⦂ centry_tag (ce_ass ak_propositional A) Γ ρσ ≈ ρ'σ' ↦ ⋆ᵈ⟨N, ρ'σ'⟩ ⦂ centry_tag (ce_ass ak_propositional A) Γ ρ'σ' ∈ env_relΓA)
    by (apply EA; exact (per_env_extend_intro_tagged HΓA0 HΓ Hρσ (per_head_proof Ha2 Hr2 Rp2 Rp3))).
  destruct (rel_type_body_of_retagged HΓA HBgen _ _ HΓ _ _ HidN ρσ ρ'σ'
              (ρσ ↦ ⋆ᵈ⟨N, ρσ⟩ ⦂ centry_tag (ce_ass ak_propositional A) Γ ρσ) (ρ'σ' ↦ ⋆ᵈ⟨N, ρ'σ'⟩ ⦂ centry_tag (ce_ass ak_propositional A) Γ ρ'σ') Hρσ
              (eval_sub_extend_proof _ _ _ _ _ _ Hid2 Hp2r) (eval_sub_extend_proof _ _ _ _ _ _ Hid3 Hp3r) Hext)
    as [t2 tB2 tB3 t3 Ht2 HtB2 HtB3 Ht3 HtBchain].
  apply rel_chain_relevant_univ in HtBchain.

The Bridge

B at the kept proof of the first instantiation against the one of the second, at the substituted pair.
  assert (Hx : Dom ρσ ↦ ⋆ᵈ⟨N[σ], ρ⟩ ⦂ centry_tag (ce_ass ak_propositional A) Γ ρσ ≈ ρ'σ' ↦ ⋆ᵈ⟨N, ρ'σ'⟩ ⦂ centry_tag (ce_ass ak_propositional A) Γ ρ'σ'
                 ∈ per_env_extend A A env_relΓ)
    by exact (per_env_extend_intro_tagged HΓA0 HΓ Hρσ (per_head_proof Ha2 Hr2 Rp1 Rp3)).
  destruct (rel_exp_of_typ_extend_simple HΓ (rel_type_of_prop 0 HA) HB _ _ Hx) as [d1 [d2 [Hd1 [Hd2 Hd]]]].
  assert (d1 = tA2) as -> by (eapply functional_eval_exp; [ exact Hd1 | exact HtA2 ]).
  assert (d2 = tB3) as -> by (eapply functional_eval_exp; [ exact Hd2 | exact HtB3 ]).
  assert (Hbridge : rel_chain (per_univ i) ([tA2; tB3]))
    by (apply rel_chain_of_pair; exact Hd).
  assert (Hchain1 : rel_chain (per_univ i) ([t1; tA2; tB3; t4]))
    by (merge_rel_chain HtAchain Hbridge tA2).
  assert (Hall : rel_chain (per_univ i) ([t1; t2; tB2; tB3; t3; t4]))
    by (merge_rel_chain Hchain1 HtBchain tB3).
Anchored at the head PER of the second instantiation.
  assert (Hmid : Dom tB2 ≈ tB3 ∈ per_univ i) by pairwise.
  pose proof (per_univ_elem_at_head HtB2 HtB3 Hmid) as Hanchor.
  assert (HallR : rel_chain (per_univ_elem i (per_head B B (ρσ ↦ ⋆ᵈ⟨N, ρσ⟩ ⦂ centry_tag (ce_ass ak_propositional A) Γ ρσ)
                                                       (ρ'σ' ↦ ⋆ᵈ⟨N, ρ'σ'⟩ ⦂ centry_tag (ce_ass ak_propositional A) Γ ρ'σ')))
                    ([t1; t2; tB2; tB3; t3; t4]))
    by (eapply per_univ_chain_at_in; [ exact Hall | | | exact Hanchor ]; solve_in).
  exists a1, a2, a3, a4.
  do 5 (split; [ assumption |]).
  apply (mk_rel_exp t1 t2 t3 t4); try eassumption.
  solve_rel_chain.
Qed.

Application of a function of a proof: the argument is not evaluated, and every link applies the two functions to the two kept proofs of its environments, ⋆ᵈ⟨N[σ], ρ⟩, ⋆ᵈ⟨N, ρσ⟩, ⋆ᵈ⟨N', ρ'σ'⟩ and ⋆ᵈ⟨N'[σ'], ρ'⟩ in turn.
Lemma rel_exp_under_ctx_app_cong_prop : forall {Γ A} {i : nat} {B M M' N N'},
    Γ ⊨ A : Propₘ ->
    Γ ▹{ak_propositional} A ⊨ B ≈ B : Typeω@i ->
    Γ ⊨ M ≈ M' : Π{ak_propositional} A B ->
    Γ ⊨ N ≈ N' : A ->
    exp_scoped (List.length Γ) N ->
    exp_scoped (List.length Γ) N' ->
    Γ ⊨ M $ N ≈ M' $ N' : B[Id ,, N].
Proof.
  intros * HA HB HM HN HNs HN's.
  pose proof (rel_exp_under_ctx_refl_left HN) as HNl.
  pose proof (rel_exp_of_prop_inversion HA) as [env_relΓ [HΓ _]].
  destruct HM as [? ? k HMgen].
  eexists_rel_exp_with i.
  intros Γ' env_rel' HΓ' σ σ' Hσj ρ ρ' ρσ ρ'σ' Hρ Hev Hev'.
  destruct (rel_typ_of_instance_prop HA HB HNl HNs _ _ HΓ' _ _ _ _ _ _ Hσj Hρ Hev Hev')
    as [a1 [a2 [a3 [a4 [Ha1 [Ha2 [Ha3 [Ha4 [Hachain Htyp]]]]]]]]].
  exists (per_head B B (ρσ ↦ ⋆ᵈ⟨N, ρσ⟩ ⦂ centry_tag (ce_ass ak_propositional A) Γ ρσ) (ρ'σ' ↦ ⋆ᵈ⟨N, ρ'σ'⟩ ⦂ centry_tag (ce_ass ak_propositional A) Γ ρ'σ')).
  split; [ exact Htyp |]; right.
  assert (Hρσ : Dom ρσ ≈ ρ'σ' ∈ env_relΓ)
    by (eapply (rel_sub_under_ctx_at' Hσj HΓ' HΓ); eassumption).
  pose proof Hachain as (_ & H23 & _).
  pose proof (per_univ_elem_of_prop k _ _ H23) as Hmid.
  destruct H23 as [Er2 Er3 _].

The Kept Proofs

The four arguments and the instance's, all readable as the arguments are scoped.
  pose proof Hσj as [? _ ? _ _ Hσs].
  assert (HNσ : exp_scoped (List.length Γ') N[σ])
    by (eapply exp_scoped_sub; [ exact HNs | intros x Hx; exact (proj1 (Hσs x Hx)) ]).
  assert (HN'σ' : exp_scoped (List.length Γ') N'[σ'])
    by (eapply exp_scoped_sub; [ exact HN's | intros x Hx; exact (proj2 (Hσs x Hx)) ]).
  destruct (per_ctx_env_kept_proof_readable _ _ _ N[σ] HΓ' (exp_scoped_free_bound _ _ HNσ) _ _ Hρ) as [Rp1 _].
  destruct (per_ctx_env_kept_proof_readable _ _ _ N'[σ'] HΓ' (exp_scoped_free_bound _ _ HN'σ') _ _ Hρ) as [_ Rp4].
  destruct (per_ctx_env_kept_proof_readable _ _ _ N HΓ (exp_scoped_free_bound _ _ HNs) _ _ Hρσ) as [Rp2 Rp2'].
  destruct (per_ctx_env_kept_proof_readable _ _ _ N' HΓ (exp_scoped_free_bound _ _ HN's) _ _ Hρσ) as [_ Rp3].
Each link arrives in the head PER of its own pair of proofs, at the tags of the type's domain values; per_head_codomain_resp moves it to the instance's.
  pose proof (per_ctx_env_of_typ (κ := ak_propositional) HΓ (rel_type_of_prop 0 HA)) as HΓA0.
  destruct (per_head_closure_readable HΓA0 HΓ Hρσ (per_head_proof (S' := A) (ρ' := ρ'σ') Ha2 Er2 Rp2 Rp2'))
    as [RN2 RN2'].
  assert (Hmove : forall x y, proof_readable x -> proof_readable y ->
             per_head B B (ρσ ↦ x ⦂ entry_type_value a2) (ρ'σ' ↦ y ⦂ entry_type_value a3) <~>
             per_head B B (ρσ ↦ ⋆ᵈ⟨N, ρσ⟩ ⦂ centry_tag (ce_ass ak_propositional A) Γ ρσ) (ρ'σ' ↦ ⋆ᵈ⟨N, ρ'σ'⟩ ⦂ centry_tag (ce_ass ak_propositional A) Γ ρ'σ')).
  { intros x y Rx Ry.
    assert (Hxy : Dom x ≈ y ∈ per_proof) by (split; assumption).
    pose proof (entry_readable_of_elem Hmid Hxy) as [Ex Ey].
    exact (per_head_codomain_resp HΓ (rel_type_of_prop 0 HA) (rel_type_of_typ HB) _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _
             Hρσ Ha2 Ha3 Hmid Hxy (conj Rp2 Rp2') (conj Rp2 Ry) Ex Ey RN2 RN2'). }
  destruct (HMgen _ _ HΓ' _ _ Hσj _ _ _ _ Hρ Hev Hev') as [RM [HMtyp HMexp]].
  assert (HΠr : rel_typ_evaluated (Π{ak_propositional} A B) ρσ)
    by (exists (Πᵈ{ak_propositional} a2 ρσ B); split; [ apply eval_exp_pi; exact Ha2 | constructor ]).
  apply (rel_exp_or_prop_evaluated HMtyp HΠr) in HMexp.
  destruct HMtyp as [c1 c2 c3 c4 Hc1 Hc2 Hc3 Hc4 Hcchain].
  destruct HMexp as [m1 m2 m3 m4 Hm1 Hm2 Hm3 Hm4 Hmchain].
  assert (c2 = Πᵈ{ak_propositional} a2 ρσ B) as ->
    by (eapply functional_eval_exp; [ exact Hc2 | apply eval_exp_pi; exact Ha2 ]).
  assert (c3 = Πᵈ{ak_propositional} a3 ρ'σ' B) as ->
    by (eapply functional_eval_exp; [ exact Hc3 | apply eval_exp_pi; exact Ha3 ]).
  assert (HRMmid : DF Πᵈ{ak_propositional} a2 ρσ B ≈ Πᵈ{ak_propositional} a3 ρ'σ' B ∈ per_univ_elem k ↘ RM) by pairwise.
  rewrite (per_pi_iff evaluated_kind_relevant Hmid HRMmid) in Hmchain.
  destruct Hmchain as (Hpi1 & Hpi2 & Hpi3).
  destruct (pi_elements_app _ _ _ _ _ _ Hpi1 _ _ (conj Rp1 Rp2)) as [r1 r2 Hr1 Hr2 Hr].
  destruct (pi_elements_app _ _ _ _ _ _ Hpi2 _ _ (conj Rp2 Rp3)) as [s1 s2 Hs1 Hs2 Hs].
  destruct (pi_elements_app _ _ _ _ _ _ Hpi3 _ _ (conj Rp3 Rp4)) as [u1 u2 Hu1 Hu2 Hu].
  assert (Hs1e : s1 = r2) by (eapply functional_eval_app; [ exact Hs1 | exact Hr2 ]).
  assert (Hu1e : u1 = s2) by (eapply functional_eval_app; [ exact Hu1 | exact Hs2 ]).
  subst s1 u1.
The functions take proofs.
  assert (Ef1 : arg_kind gc_deps gc_stack m1 = ak_propositional) by (rewrite (pi_elements_left _ _ _ _ _ _ Hpi1); exact Er2).
  assert (Ef2 : arg_kind gc_deps gc_stack m2 = ak_propositional) by (rewrite (pi_elements_right _ _ _ _ _ _ Hpi1); exact Er3).
  assert (Ef3 : arg_kind gc_deps gc_stack m3 = ak_propositional) by (rewrite (pi_elements_right _ _ _ _ _ _ Hpi2); exact Er3).
  assert (Ef4 : arg_kind gc_deps gc_stack m4 = ak_propositional) by (rewrite (pi_elements_right _ _ _ _ _ _ Hpi3); exact Er3).
  apply (mk_rel_exp r1 r2 s2 u2);
    [ eapply eval_exp_app_proof; [ exact Hm1 | exact Ef1 | exact Hr1 ]
    | eapply eval_exp_app_proof; [ exact Hm2 | exact Ef2 | exact Hr2 ]
    | eapply eval_exp_app_proof; [ exact Hm3 | exact Ef3 | exact Hs2 ]
    | eapply eval_exp_app_proof; [ exact Hm4 | exact Ef4 | exact Hu2 ]
    |].
  apply rel_chain_4;
    [ apply (Hmove _ _ Rp1 Rp2); exact Hr | apply (Hmove _ _ Rp2 Rp3); exact Hs | apply (Hmove _ _ Rp3 Rp4); exact Hu ].
Qed.

The codomain of a ∀ at an argument is a proposition: its instance along Id ,, N, which is built from valid parts.
Lemma rel_exp_under_ctx_instance : forall {Γ κ A Srt B B' C N},
    ⊨ Γ ->
    sort_kind Srt κ ->
    Γ ⊨ A : Srt ->
    Γ ▹{κ} A ⊨ B ≈ B' : C ->
    Γ ⊨ N : A ->
    exp_scoped (List.length Γ) N ->
    Γ ⊨ B[Id,,N] ≈ B'[Id,,N] : C[Id,,N].
Proof.
  intros * HΓ HS HA HB HN HNs.
  eapply rel_exp_under_ctx_gsub; [| exact HB ].
  eapply gsub_ass; [ apply gsub_id; exact HΓ | exact HS | exact HA | rewrite exp_sub_id; exact HN | exact HNs ].
Qed.

End Fixed_GCtx.

Application of a function or of a proof of a ∀.
Lemma sem_exp_eq_app_cong :
  `( Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊨ A : Srt ->
     sort_kind Srt κd ->
     Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ▹{κd} A ⊨ B : abs_kind_sort κc Typeω@i ->
     pi_kinds κd κc ->
     Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊨ M ≈ M' : a_pi κd κc A B ->
     Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊨ N ≈ N' : A ->
     exp_scoped (List.length Γ) N ->
     exp_scoped (List.length Γ) N' ->
     Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊨ M $ N ≈ M' $ N' : B[Id,,N] ).
Proof.
  intros * HA HS HB Hk HM HN HNs HN's; sem_intro; [ assumption |].
  destruct Hk as [κd | κd |]; cbn [abs_kind_sort] in *.
  - destruct HS.
    + exact (rel_exp_under_ctx_app_cong (rel_type_of_typ HA) (rel_type_kind_of_typ HA) evaluated_kind_relevant
               evaluated_kind_relevant (rel_type_of_typ HB) HM HN HNs).
    + exact (rel_exp_under_ctx_app_cong_prop HA HB HM HN HNs HN's).
    + exact (rel_exp_under_ctx_app_cong (rel_type_of_level_sort 0 HA) (rel_type_kind_of_level_sort HA) evaluated_kind_level
               evaluated_kind_relevant (rel_type_of_typ HB) HM HN HNs).
  - apply rel_exp_under_ctx_proof.
    match goal with HΓ : ⊨ Γ |- _ =>
      exact (rel_exp_under_ctx_instance HΓ HS HA HB (rel_exp_under_ctx_refl_left HN) HNs) end.
  - inversion HS; subst.
    exact (rel_exp_under_ctx_app_cong (rel_type_of_level_sort 0 HA) (rel_type_kind_of_level_sort HA) evaluated_kind_level
             evaluated_kind_level (rel_type_of_level_sort 0 HB) HM HN HNs).
Qed.

Lemma sem_app :
  `( Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊨ A : Srt ->
     sort_kind Srt κd ->
     Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ▹{κd} A ⊨ B : abs_kind_sort κc Typeω@i ->
     pi_kinds κd κc ->
     Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊨ M : a_pi κd κc A B ->
     Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊨ N : A ->
     exp_scoped (List.length Γ) N ->
     Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊨ M $ N : B[Id,,N] ).
Proof.
  intros * HA HS HB Hk HM HN HNs;
    eapply sem_exp_eq_app_cong; [ exact HA | exact HS | exact HB | exact Hk | exact HM | exact HN | exact HNs | exact HNs ].
Qed.

Section Fixed_GCtx.
  Context {GC : GCtx}.

β

The type is B[Id,,N] again, so rel_typ_of_instance settles it, and what it also reports (N's four values, their PER, and the codomain at an arbitrary related pair) is what the term side needs. No type judgment is instantiated here.
The four values of the term are ⟦M[q σ]⟧(ρ ↦ n1), ⟦M⟧(ρσ ↦ n2), ⟦M[Id,,N]⟧ρ'σ' and ⟦M[Id,,N][σ']⟧ρ'. The first holds because ((λ A M) N)[σ] is (λ A[σ] M[q σ]) (N[σ]) and applying a closure evaluates its body in the extended environment (eval_app_fn). So the redex adds no evaluation of its own: the first link is the first obligation of rel_exp_under_ctx_q at the argument pair n1 ≈ n2.
The other two values need the same two instantiations of M's judgment that the type needed of B's (along σ ,, N[σ] for the outer one, along Id ,, N at the substituted environments for the inner one) and the same bridge, which here is M at the crossing pair of arguments. A second bridge joins the redex's second value, M at the closure's tag entry_type_value a2, to the inner instantiation's, at centry_tag. Merges then select the goal's four values, all in the canonical head PER. The domain is any relevant type: of a universe, or of LevelSort.
Lemma rel_exp_under_ctx_pi_beta : forall {Γ κd A B M N} {i j : nat},
    Γ ⊨ᵗ A ≈ A at j ->
    rel_type_kind Γ A κd ->
    evaluated_kind κd ->
    Γ ▹{κd} A ⊨ᵗ B ≈ B at i ->
    rel_type_evaluated (Γ ▹{κd} A) B ->
    Γ ▹{κd} A ⊨ M : B ->
    Γ ⊨ N : A ->
    exp_scoped (List.length Γ) N ->
    Γ ⊨ (λ A M) $ N ≈ M[Id,,N] : B[Id,,N].
Proof.
  intros * HA HAk HAe HB HBr HM HN HNs.
  assert (HArel : rel_type_evaluated Γ A) by (exists κd; split; assumption).
  pose proof (rel_type_inversion HA) as [env_relΓ [HΓ HAgen]].
  pose proof HA as HAt.
  pose proof (per_ctx_env_of_typ (κ := κd) HΓ HAt) as HΓA.
  pose proof (rel_type_under_ctx_not_level_sort _ _ _ _ HA) as HAn.
  pose proof (rel_sub_under_ctx_extend_sub (κ := κd) (rel_sub_id (ex_intro _ _ HΓ)) HN HAn HNs HNs) as HidN.
  rewrite exp_sub_id in HidN.
  pose proof HBr as (rB & HrB & HBk).
  assert (HBrel : forall ρ ρ' R, EF Γ ▹{κd} A ≈ Γ ▹{κd} A ∈ per_ctx_env ↘ R -> Dom ρ ≈ ρ' ∈ R -> rel_typ_evaluated B ρ)
    by (intros * HR Hρ; exact (rel_typ_evaluated_of_kind (HBk _ HR _ _ Hρ) HrB)).
  pose proof HM as [env_relΓAM HΓAM k HMgen].
  assert (EAM : env_relΓAM <~> per_env_extend A A env_relΓ) by (eapply per_ctx_env_right_irrel; eassumption).
  eexists_rel_exp_with i.
  intros Γ' env_rel' HΓ' σ σ' Hσj ρ ρ' ρσ ρ'σ' Hρ Hev Hev'.
  destruct (rel_typ_of_instance HA HArel HB HN HNs _ _ HΓ' _ _ _ _ _ _ Hσj Hρ Hev Hev')
    as [l [RN [a1 [a2 [a3 [a4 [n1 [n2 [n3 [n4 [Ha1 [Ha2 [Ha3 [Ha4 [Houter
       [Hmid [Hn1 [Hn2 [Hn3 [Hn4 [Hnchain [Hcod Htyp]]]]]]]]]]]]]]]]]]]]]].
  exists (per_head B B (ρσ ↦ n2 ⦂ centry_tag (ce_ass κd A) Γ ρσ) (ρ'σ' ↦ n3 ⦂ centry_tag (ce_ass κd A) Γ ρ'σ')).
  split; [ exact Htyp |]; right.
  assert (Hρσ : Dom ρσ ≈ ρ'σ' ∈ env_relΓ)
    by (eapply (rel_sub_under_ctx_at' Hσj HΓ' HΓ); eassumption).
  pose proof (head_not_propositional_of_evaluated (e := ce_ass κd A) HΓ eq_refl HA HArel _ _ Hρσ) as [Hnp2 Hnp3].
  pose proof (head_not_propositional_of_evaluated (e := ce_ass κd A) HΓ eq_refl HA HArel _ _
                (per_ctx_env_retag HΓ _ _ Hρσ)) as [Hnp2r Hnp3r].
  destruct (eval_sub_id_rel HΓ Hρσ) as [Hid2 Hid3].
The argument pairs the links are read at.
  assert (Hn12 : Dom n1 ≈ n2 ∈ RN) by pairwise.
  assert (Hn13 : Dom n1 ≈ n3 ∈ RN) by pairwise.
  assert (Hn14 : Dom n1 ≈ n4 ∈ RN) by pairwise.
  assert (Hn22 : Dom n2 ≈ n2 ∈ RN) by pairwise.
  assert (Hn23 : Dom n2 ≈ n3 ∈ RN) by pairwise.
  assert (Hn24 : Dom n2 ≈ n4 ∈ RN) by pairwise.
The instance's heads read back at A over the substituted environments (per_head_closure_readable).
  destruct (per_head_closure_readable HΓA HΓ Hρσ (per_head_of Ha2 Ha3 Hmid Hn23)) as [Rn2T Rn3T].

The Redex

rel_exp_under_ctx_q at the argument pair n1 ≈ n2, with the closures' tags on the left: the values of their domains. Its element PER is moved to the instance's (per_head_codomain_resp).
  pose proof (entry_readable_of_elem Houter Hn12) as [Rn1a1 _].
  pose proof (entry_readable_of_elem Houter Hn22) as [Rn2a1 _].
  pose proof (entry_readable_of_elem Hmid Hn12) as [Rn1a2 _].
  pose proof (entry_readable_of_elem Hmid Hn22) as [Rn2a2 _].
  pose proof (per_env_extend_sub_intro HΓ' Hσj HAt _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hρ Ha1 Houter Hn12
                Rn1a1 Rn2a1) as Hpair.
  assert (Hts : args_readable_at n1 n2
                  ([entry_type_value a1; entry_type_value a2; entry_type_value a2; entry_type_value a1]))
    by (repeat constructor; assumption).
  destruct (rel_exp_under_ctx_q HΓ' Hσj HAt HM HBrel _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hpair Hts Hev Hev')
    as [[v1 [v2 [Hv1 [Hv2 Hv]]]] _].
  clear Hpair.
  assert (Hlink1 : Dom v1 ≈ v2 ∈ per_head B B (ρσ ↦ n2 ⦂ centry_tag (ce_ass κd A) Γ ρσ) (ρ'σ' ↦ n3 ⦂ centry_tag (ce_ass κd A) Γ ρ'σ'))
    by (apply (per_head_codomain_resp HΓ HAt HB _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _
                 Hρσ Ha2 Ha3 Hmid Hn12 Hn23 Hn22 Rn1a2 Rn2a2 Rn2T Rn3T); exact Hv).
  apply rel_chain_of_pair in Hlink1.

The Outer Instantiation

Along σ ,, N[σ] ≈ σ' ,, N[σ'], whose right-hand outer value is the goal's fourth once exp_sub_extend_sub has rewritten it.
  destruct (HMgen _ _ HΓ' _ _ (rel_sub_under_ctx_extend_sub (κ := κd) Hσj HN HAn HNs HNs) _ _ _ _ Hρ
                  (eval_sub_extend _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hev Hnp2 Hn1)
                  (eval_sub_extend _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hev' Hnp3 Hn4))
    as [RA [HAtyp HAexp]].
  apply (rel_exp_or_prop_evaluated HAtyp
           (HBrel _ _ _ HΓA (per_env_extend_intro_tagged HΓA HΓ Hρσ (per_head_of Ha2 Ha3 Hmid Hn14)))) in HAexp.
  destruct HAtyp as [cA1 cA2 cA3 cA4 HcA1 HcA2 HcA3 HcA4 HcAchain].
  destruct HAexp as [h1 h2 h3 h4 Hh1 Hh2 Hh3 Hh4 Hhchain].
  rewrite <- exp_sub_extend_sub in Hh4.
  destruct (per_head_anchor Hcod n1 n4 n2 n3 Hn14 Hn23 Hn24)
    as [e1 [e2 [He1 [He2 HanchorA]]]].
  assert (e1 = cA2) as -> by (eapply functional_eval_exp; [ exact He1 | exact HcA2 ]).
  assert (e2 = cA3) as -> by (eapply functional_eval_exp; [ exact He2 | exact HcA3 ]).
  retype_rel_chain HcAchain HanchorA Hhchain.

The Inner Instantiation

Along Id ,, N ≈ Id ,, N at the substituted environments, whose results are the extensions of the retagged environments; read at the extensions of the environments themselves (rel_exp_body_of_retagged). Its second value is the goal's second and its right-hand outer value the goal's third.
  assert (Hext : Dom ρσ ↦ n2 ⦂ centry_tag (ce_ass κd A) Γ ρσ ≈ ρ'σ' ↦ n3 ⦂ centry_tag (ce_ass κd A) Γ ρ'σ' ∈ per_env_extend A A env_relΓ)
    by exact (per_env_extend_intro_tagged HΓA HΓ Hρσ (per_head_of Ha2 Ha3 Hmid Hn23)).
  destruct (rel_exp_body_of_retagged HΓAM HMgen _ _ HΓ _ _ HidN ρσ ρ'σ'
              (ρσ ↦ n2 ⦂ centry_tag (ce_ass κd A) Γ ρσ) (ρ'σ' ↦ n3 ⦂ centry_tag (ce_ass κd A) Γ ρ'σ') Hρσ
              (eval_sub_extend _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hid2 Hnp2r Hn2) (eval_sub_extend _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hid3 Hnp3r Hn3)
              (proj2 (EAM _ _) Hext))
    as [RB [HBtyp HBexp]].
  apply (rel_exp_or_prop_evaluated HBtyp (HBrel _ _ _ HΓA Hext)) in HBexp.
  destruct HBtyp as [cB1 cB2 cB3 cB4 HcB1 HcB2 HcB3 HcB4 HcBchain].
  destruct HBexp as [g1 g2 g3 g4 Hg1 Hg2 Hg3 Hg4 Hgchain].
  destruct (per_head_anchor Hcod n2 n3 n2 n3 Hn23 Hn23 Hn23)
    as [f1 [f2 [Hf1 [Hf2 HanchorB]]]].
  assert (f1 = cB2) as -> by (eapply functional_eval_exp; [ exact Hf1 | exact HcB2 ]).
  assert (f2 = cB3) as -> by (eapply functional_eval_exp; [ exact Hf2 | exact HcB3 ]).
  retype_rel_chain HcBchain HanchorB Hgchain.
The goal's second value is the redex's, M at the closure's tag, and this instantiation's second is M at centry_tag: M relates the two, and the head PER moves along the chain of extensions ending at the instance's pair.
  assert (PER env_relΓ) by (eapply per_env_PER; eassumption).
  assert (PER (per_env_extend A A env_relΓ)) by (eapply per_env_PER; exact HΓA).
  assert (H22 : DF a2 ≈ a2 ∈ per_univ_elem l ↘ RN) by (etransitivity; [ exact Hmid | symmetry; exact Hmid ]).
  assert (Htag : Dom ρσ ↦ n2 ⦂ entry_type_value a2 ≈ ρσ ↦ n2 ⦂ centry_tag (ce_ass κd A) Γ ρσ ∈ per_env_extend A A env_relΓ)
    by (apply per_env_extend_intro';
        [ etransitivity; [ exact Hρσ | symmetry; exact Hρσ ] | exact (per_head_of Ha2 Ha2 H22 Hn22)
        | exact Rn2a2 | exact Rn2T ]).
  destruct (rel_exp_under_ctx_extend_simple HΓ HAt HM _ _ Htag) as [Hp' | [w1 [w2 [Hw1 [Hw2 Hw]]]]].
  { exfalso; destruct (HBrel _ _ _ HΓA Htag) as (x & Ex & Hx).
    destruct Hp' as (y & Ey & Hy); functional_eval_rewrite_clear; kind_congruence. }
  assert (w1 = v2) as -> by (eapply functional_eval_exp; [ exact Hw1 | exact Hv2 ]).
  assert (w2 = g2) as -> by (eapply functional_eval_exp; [ exact Hw2 | exact Hg2 ]).
  assert (Hlink2 : Dom v2 ≈ g2 ∈ per_head B B (ρσ ↦ n2 ⦂ centry_tag (ce_ass κd A) Γ ρσ) (ρ'σ' ↦ n3 ⦂ centry_tag (ce_ass κd A) Γ ρ'σ')).
  { assert (Hch : rel_chain (per_env_extend A A env_relΓ)
                    ([ρσ ↦ n2 ⦂ entry_type_value a2; ρσ ↦ n2 ⦂ centry_tag (ce_ass κd A) Γ ρσ;
                      ρσ ↦ n2 ⦂ centry_tag (ce_ass κd A) Γ ρσ; ρ'σ' ↦ n3 ⦂ centry_tag (ce_ass κd A) Γ ρ'σ']))
      by (apply rel_chain_4; [ exact Htag | etransitivity; [ symmetry |]; exact Htag | exact Hext ]).
    pose proof (per_head_of_type_resp HΓA HB _ _ _ _ Hch) as Hr.
    apply Hr; exact Hw. }
  apply rel_chain_of_pair in Hlink2.

The Bridge

M at the pair of arguments that crosses from the one instantiation to the other; the codomain there is relevant.
  assert (Hcross : Dom ρσ ↦ n1 ⦂ centry_tag (ce_ass κd A) Γ ρσ ≈ ρ'σ' ↦ n3 ⦂ centry_tag (ce_ass κd A) Γ ρ'σ' ∈ per_env_extend A A env_relΓ)
    by exact (per_env_extend_intro_tagged HΓA HΓ Hρσ (per_head_of Ha2 Ha3 Hmid Hn13)).
  destruct (rel_exp_under_ctx_extend_simple HΓ HAt HM _ _ Hcross)
    as [Hp | [b1 [b2 [Hb1 [Hb2 Hb]]]]].
  { exfalso; destruct (HBrel _ _ _ HΓA Hcross) as (x & Ex & Hx).
    destruct Hp as (y & Ey & Hy); functional_eval_rewrite_clear; kind_congruence. }
  assert (b1 = h2) as -> by (eapply functional_eval_exp; [ exact Hb1 | exact Hh2 ]).
  assert (b2 = g3) as -> by (eapply functional_eval_exp; [ exact Hb2 | exact Hg3 ]).
  assert (Hbridge : Dom h2 ≈ g3 ∈ per_head B B (ρσ ↦ n2 ⦂ centry_tag (ce_ass κd A) Γ ρσ) (ρ'σ' ↦ n3 ⦂ centry_tag (ce_ass κd A) Γ ρ'σ'))
    by (apply (per_head_of_args Hcod n1 n3 n2 n3 Hn13 Hn23 Hn23); exact Hb).
  apply rel_chain_of_pair in Hbridge.

The Four Values

  assert (Hmerge1 : rel_chain (per_head B B (ρσ ↦ n2 ⦂ centry_tag (ce_ass κd A) Γ ρσ) (ρ'σ' ↦ n3 ⦂ centry_tag (ce_ass κd A) Γ ρ'σ')) ([h4; g3]))
    by (merge_rel_chain Hhchain Hbridge h2).
  assert (Hmerge2 : rel_chain (per_head B B (ρσ ↦ n2 ⦂ centry_tag (ce_ass κd A) Γ ρσ) (ρ'σ' ↦ n3 ⦂ centry_tag (ce_ass κd A) Γ ρ'σ')) ([g2; g4; h4]))
    by (merge_rel_chain Hmerge1 Hgchain g3).
The redex takes a relevant argument on both sides: the values of A along σ are relevant, as A is at the substituted environments.
  destruct (HAk _ HΓ _ _ Hρσ) as (a2' & Ha2' & Er2k).
  assert (a2' = a2) as -> by (eapply functional_eval_exp; eassumption).
  assert (Er2 : evaluated_kind (domain_kind a2)) by (rewrite Er2k; exact HAe).
  destruct (HAgen _ _ HΓ' _ _ Hσj _ _ _ _ Hρ Hev Hev') as [x1 x2 x3 x4 Hx1 Hx2 Hx3 Hx4 Hxchain].
  assert (x1 = a1) as -> by (eapply functional_eval_exp; eassumption).
  assert (x2 = a2) as -> by (eapply functional_eval_exp; eassumption).
  assert (Hx12 : Dom a1 ≈ a2 ∈ per_univ j) by pairwise.
  destruct Hx12 as [Rx Hx12].
  assert (Er1 : evaluated_kind (domain_kind a1)) by (rewrite (per_univ_elem_kind _ _ _ _ Hx12); exact Er2).
  assert (Hmerge3 : rel_chain (per_head B B (ρσ ↦ n2 ⦂ centry_tag (ce_ass κd A) Γ ρσ) (ρ'σ' ↦ n3 ⦂ centry_tag (ce_ass κd A) Γ ρ'σ'))
                      ([v2; g2; g4; h4]))
    by (merge_rel_chain Hlink2 Hmerge2 g2).
  apply (mk_rel_exp v1 v2 g4 h4);
    [ eapply eval_exp_app; [ apply eval_exp_fn; exact Ha1 | exact Er1 | exact Hn1 | apply eval_app_fn; exact Hv1 ]
    | eapply eval_exp_app; [ apply eval_exp_fn; exact Ha2 | exact Er2 | exact Hn2 | apply eval_app_fn; exact Hv2 ]
    | exact Hg4
    | exact Hh4
    |].
  merge_rel_chain Hlink1 Hmerge3 v2.
Qed.

β for a function of a proof. The argument is kept unevaluated: the redex applies the two closures to ⋆ᵈ⟨N[σ], ρ⟩ and ⋆ᵈ⟨N, ρσ⟩, the outer instantiation of M extends by ⋆ᵈ⟨N[σ], ρ⟩ and ⋆ᵈ⟨N[σ'], ρ'⟩, the inner one by ⋆ᵈ⟨N, ρσ⟩ and ⋆ᵈ⟨N, ρ'σ'⟩. Any two readable proofs are related at the head of a proposition, so the shape is that of rel_exp_under_ctx_pi_beta, each move of a head PER between argument pairs by per_head_codomain_resp.
Lemma rel_exp_under_ctx_pi_beta_prop : forall {Γ A B M N} {i : nat},
    Γ ⊨ A : Propₘ ->
    Γ ▹{ak_propositional} A ⊨ B : Typeω@i ->
    Γ ▹{ak_propositional} A ⊨ M : B ->
    Γ ⊨ N : A ->
    exp_scoped (List.length Γ) N ->
    Γ ⊨ (λ A M) $ N ≈ M[Id,,N] : B[Id,,N].
Proof.
  intros * HA HB HM HN HNs.
  pose proof (rel_exp_of_prop_inversion HA) as [env_relΓ [HΓ _]].
  pose proof (rel_type_of_prop i HA) as HAt.
  pose proof (per_ctx_env_of_typ (κ := ak_propositional) HΓ HAt) as HΓA.
  pose proof (rel_exp_of_prop_not_level_sort HA) as HAn.
  pose proof (rel_sub_under_ctx_extend_sub (κ := ak_propositional) (rel_sub_id (ex_intro _ _ HΓ)) HN HAn HNs HNs) as HidN.
  rewrite exp_sub_id in HidN.
  assert (HBrel : forall ρ ρ' R, EF Γ ▹{ak_propositional} A ≈ Γ ▹{ak_propositional} A ∈ per_ctx_env ↘ R ->
                    Dom ρ ≈ ρ' ∈ R -> rel_typ_evaluated B ρ)
    by (intros * HR Hρ; exact (rel_exp_of_typ_evaluated_at HR HB _ _ Hρ)).
  pose proof HM as [env_relΓAM HΓAM k HMgen].
  assert (EAM : env_relΓAM <~> per_env_extend A A env_relΓ) by (eapply per_ctx_env_right_irrel; eassumption).
  assert (PER env_relΓ) by (eapply per_env_PER; eassumption).
  assert (PER (per_env_extend A A env_relΓ)) by (eapply per_env_PER; exact HΓA).
  eexists_rel_exp_with i.
  intros Γ' env_rel' HΓ' σ σ' Hσj ρ ρ' ρσ ρ'σ' Hρ Hev Hev'.
  destruct (rel_typ_of_instance_prop HA HB HN HNs _ _ HΓ' _ _ _ _ _ _ Hσj Hρ Hev Hev')
    as [a1 [a2 [a3 [a4 [Ha1 [Ha2 [Ha3 [Ha4 [Hachain Htyp]]]]]]]]].
  exists (per_head B B (ρσ ↦ ⋆ᵈ⟨N, ρσ⟩ ⦂ centry_tag (ce_ass ak_propositional A) Γ ρσ) (ρ'σ' ↦ ⋆ᵈ⟨N, ρ'σ'⟩ ⦂ centry_tag (ce_ass ak_propositional A) Γ ρ'σ')).
  split; [ exact Htyp |]; right.
  assert (Hρσ : Dom ρσ ≈ ρ'σ' ∈ env_relΓ)
    by (eapply (rel_sub_under_ctx_at' Hσj HΓ' HΓ); eassumption).
  pose proof Hachain as ([Hr1 _ _] & [Hr2 Hr3 _] & _).
  assert (Ha14 : DF a1 ≈ a4 ∈ per_univ_elem i ↘ per_proof) by (apply per_univ_elem_of_prop; pairwise).
  assert (Ha23 : DF a2 ≈ a3 ∈ per_univ_elem i ↘ per_proof) by (apply per_univ_elem_of_prop; pairwise).
  pose proof (head_propositional_of_value (Γ := Γ) (κ := ak_propositional) Ha2 Hr2) as Hp2.
  pose proof (head_propositional_of_value (Γ := Γ) (κ := ak_propositional) Ha3 Hr3) as Hp3.
  destruct (rel_exp_of_prop_inversion_simple_at HΓ HA _ _ (per_ctx_env_retag HΓ _ _ Hρσ))
    as (a2r & a3r & Ha2r & Ha3r & [Hl2r Hr3r _]).

  pose proof (head_propositional_of_value (Γ := Γ) (κ := ak_propositional) Ha3r Hr3r) as Hp3r.

Readable proofs read back stored at A over the substituted environments (per_head_closure_readable).

             entry_readable (de_term x (centry_tag (ce_ass ak_propositional A) Γ ρσ)) /\ entry_readable (de_term y (centry_tag (ce_ass ak_propositional A) Γ ρ'σ')))

The Kept Proofs

  pose proof Hσj as [? _ ? _ _ Hσs].

Any head PER of B at a pair of readable proofs, at readable tags, is the instance's.

The Redex

rel_exp_under_ctx_q at the pair of kept proofs ⋆ᵈ⟨N[σ], ρ⟩ and ⋆ᵈ⟨N, ρσ⟩, with the closures' tags on the left.
  pose proof (entry_readable_of_elem Ha14 (conj Rp1 Rp2)) as [Re1a1 _].
  pose proof (entry_readable_of_elem Ha14 (conj Rp2 Rp2)) as [Re2a1 _].

                  ([entry_type_value a1; entry_type_value a2; entry_type_value a2; entry_type_value a1]))

The Outer Instantiation

Along σ ,, N[σ] ≈ σ' ,, N[σ'].

The Inner Instantiation

Along Id ,, N ≈ Id ,, N at the substituted environments, read at the extensions of the environments themselves (rel_exp_body_of_retagged).
  destruct (rel_exp_body_of_retagged HΓAM HMgen _ _ HΓ _ _ HidN ρσ ρ'σ'
              (ρσ ↦ ⋆ᵈ⟨N, ρσ⟩ ⦂ centry_tag (ce_ass ak_propositional A) Γ ρσ) (ρ'σ' ↦ ⋆ᵈ⟨N, ρ'σ'⟩ ⦂ centry_tag (ce_ass ak_propositional A) Γ ρ'σ') Hρσ

The Bridges

M at the pair of kept proofs crossing from the outer instantiation to the inner one, and at the redex's tag against the inner one's.
  assert (Hcross : Dom ρσ ↦ ⋆ᵈ⟨N[σ], ρ⟩ ⦂ centry_tag (ce_ass ak_propositional A) Γ ρσ ≈ ρ'σ' ↦ ⋆ᵈ⟨N, ρ'σ'⟩ ⦂ centry_tag (ce_ass ak_propositional A) Γ ρ'σ'
                     ∈ per_env_extend A A env_relΓ)
    by exact (per_env_extend_intro_tagged HΓA HΓ Hρσ (per_head_proof Ha2 Hr2 Rp1 Rp3)).
  destruct (rel_exp_under_ctx_extend_simple HΓ HAt HM _ _ Hcross) as [Hp | [b1 [b2 [Hb1 [Hb2 Hb]]]]].
  { exfalso; destruct (HBrel _ _ _ HΓA Hcross) as (x & Ex & Hx).
    destruct Hp as (y & Ey & Hy); functional_eval_rewrite_clear; kind_congruence. }
  assert (b1 = h2) as -> by (eapply functional_eval_exp; [ exact Hb1 | exact Hh2 ]).
  assert (b2 = g3) as -> by (eapply functional_eval_exp; [ exact Hb2 | exact Hg3 ]).
  assert (Hbridge : Dom h2 ≈ g3 ∈ per_head B B (ρσ ↦ ⋆ᵈ⟨N, ρσ⟩ ⦂ centry_tag (ce_ass ak_propositional A) Γ ρσ) (ρ'σ' ↦ ⋆ᵈ⟨N, ρ'σ'⟩ ⦂ centry_tag (ce_ass ak_propositional A) Γ ρ'σ'))
    by (apply (Hmove _ _ _ _ Rp1 Rp3 (proj1 (HrT _ _ Rp1 Rp3)) (proj2 (HrT _ _ Rp1 Rp3))); exact Hb).
  apply rel_chain_of_pair in Hbridge.
  assert (Htag : Dom ρσ ↦ ⋆ᵈ⟨N, ρσ⟩ ⦂ entry_type_value a2 ≈ ρσ ↦ ⋆ᵈ⟨N, ρσ⟩ ⦂ centry_tag (ce_ass ak_propositional A) Γ ρσ
                   ∈ per_env_extend A A env_relΓ)
    by (apply per_env_extend_intro';
        [ etransitivity; [ exact Hρσ | symmetry; exact Hρσ ] | eapply per_head_proof; [ exact Ha2 | exact Hr2 | exact Rp2 | exact Rp2 ]
        | exact Re2a2 | exact (proj1 (HrT _ _ Rp2 Rp2)) ]).
  destruct (rel_exp_under_ctx_extend_simple HΓ HAt HM _ _ Htag) as [Hp' | [w1 [w2 [Hw1 [Hw2 Hw]]]]].
  { exfalso; destruct (HBrel _ _ _ HΓA Htag) as (x & Ex & Hx).
    destruct Hp' as (y & Ey & Hy); functional_eval_rewrite_clear; kind_congruence. }
  assert (w1 = v2) as -> by (eapply functional_eval_exp; [ exact Hw1 | exact Hv2 ]).
  assert (w2 = g2) as -> by (eapply functional_eval_exp; [ exact Hw2 | exact Hg2 ]).
  assert (Hlink2 : Dom v2 ≈ g2 ∈ per_head B B (ρσ ↦ ⋆ᵈ⟨N, ρσ⟩ ⦂ centry_tag (ce_ass ak_propositional A) Γ ρσ) (ρ'σ' ↦ ⋆ᵈ⟨N, ρ'σ'⟩ ⦂ centry_tag (ce_ass ak_propositional A) Γ ρ'σ')).
  { assert (Hch : rel_chain (per_env_extend A A env_relΓ)
                    ([ρσ ↦ ⋆ᵈ⟨N, ρσ⟩ ⦂ entry_type_value a2; ρσ ↦ ⋆ᵈ⟨N, ρσ⟩ ⦂ centry_tag (ce_ass ak_propositional A) Γ ρσ;
                      ρσ ↦ ⋆ᵈ⟨N, ρσ⟩ ⦂ centry_tag (ce_ass ak_propositional A) Γ ρσ; ρ'σ' ↦ ⋆ᵈ⟨N, ρ'σ'⟩ ⦂ centry_tag (ce_ass ak_propositional A) Γ ρ'σ']))
      by (apply rel_chain_4; [ exact Htag | etransitivity; [ symmetry |]; exact Htag | exact Hext ]).
    pose proof (per_head_of_type_resp HΓA (rel_type_of_typ HB) _ _ _ _ Hch) as Hr.
    apply Hr; exact Hw. }
  apply rel_chain_of_pair in Hlink2.

The Four Values

  assert (Hmerge1 : rel_chain (per_head B B (ρσ ↦ ⋆ᵈ⟨N, ρσ⟩ ⦂ centry_tag (ce_ass ak_propositional A) Γ ρσ) (ρ'σ' ↦ ⋆ᵈ⟨N, ρ'σ'⟩ ⦂ centry_tag (ce_ass ak_propositional A) Γ ρ'σ'))
                      ([h4; g3]))
    by (merge_rel_chain Hhchain Hbridge h2).
  assert (Hmerge2 : rel_chain (per_head B B (ρσ ↦ ⋆ᵈ⟨N, ρσ⟩ ⦂ centry_tag (ce_ass ak_propositional A) Γ ρσ) (ρ'σ' ↦ ⋆ᵈ⟨N, ρ'σ'⟩ ⦂ centry_tag (ce_ass ak_propositional A) Γ ρ'σ'))
                      ([g2; g4; h4]))
    by (merge_rel_chain Hmerge1 Hgchain g3).
  assert (Hmerge3 : rel_chain (per_head B B (ρσ ↦ ⋆ᵈ⟨N, ρσ⟩ ⦂ centry_tag (ce_ass ak_propositional A) Γ ρσ) (ρ'σ' ↦ ⋆ᵈ⟨N, ρ'σ'⟩ ⦂ centry_tag (ce_ass ak_propositional A) Γ ρ'σ'))
                      ([v2; g2; g4; h4]))
    by (merge_rel_chain Hlink2 Hmerge2 g2).
  apply (mk_rel_exp v1 v2 g4 h4);
    [ eapply eval_exp_app_proof; [ apply eval_exp_fn; exact Ha1 | exact Hr1 | apply eval_app_fn; exact Hv1 ]
    | eapply eval_exp_app_proof; [ apply eval_exp_fn; exact Ha2 | exact Hr2 | apply eval_app_fn; exact Hv2 ]
    | exact Hg4
    | exact Hh4
    |].
  merge_rel_chain Hlink1 Hmerge3 v2.
Qed.

End Fixed_GCtx.

Section Fixed_GCtx.
  Context {GC : GCtx}.

η

The only rule whose statement mentions a weakening rather than a substitution. M[↑]ʷ is a term in its own right, and ⟦M[↑]ʷ⟧(ρ ↦ c) is not ⟦M⟧ρ: in the λ case they are the different closures λ (ρ ↦ c) (N[wk_q ↑]ʷ) and λ ρ N. So the weakening is crossed semantically, by instantiating M's judgment along Wk with rel_exp_under_ctx_shift_at.
The type is rel_typ_of_pi unchanged. The four values of the term are ⟦M[σ]⟧ρ, ⟦M⟧ρσ, λ a3 ρ'σ' (M[↑]ʷ #0) and λ a4 ρ' ((M[↑]ʷ #0)[q σ']), the last two by eval_exp_fn. Of the three links:
  • the first is M's own left commutation;
  • the second is η proper: M and the closure of its weakened body agree on every argument. This is rel_exp_under_ctx_shift_at at the substituted environments, read at the argument pair; applying the closure evaluates M[↑]ʷ #0 in ρ'σ' ↦ c', by eval_app_fn and then the application of the function to its argument, c' itself at a relevant domain and the kept proof ⋆ᵈ⟨#0, ρ'σ' ↦ c'⟩ at a proposition, which is related to c' there;
  • the third is the right commutation of the closure, the third obligation of rel_exp_under_ctx_q for the weakened judgment Γ ▹ A ⊨ M[↑]ʷ ≈ M[↑]ʷ : (Π A B)[↑]ʷ. Its right value is ⟦M[↑]ʷ[q σ']⟧(ρ' ↦ c'), the closure body's, and the outer pair of the same weakening instance identifies its per_head of (Π A B)[↑]ʷ with per_pi.
Lemma rel_exp_under_ctx_fn_eta : forall {Γ κd κc A B M} {i : nat},
    Γ ⊨ᵗ A ≈ A at i ->
    rel_type_kind Γ A κd ->
    Γ ▹{κd} A ⊨ᵗ B ≈ B at i ->
    rel_type_kind (Γ ▹{κd} A) B κc ->
    pi_kinds κd κc -> evaluated_kind κc ->
    Γ ⊨ M : a_pi κd κc A B ->
    Γ ⊨ M ≈ λ A M[↑]ʷ $ #0 : a_pi κd κc A B.
Proof.
  intros * HA HAk HBt HBr Hk Hev0 HM.
  pose proof (rel_type_inversion HA) as [env_relΓ [HΓ _]].
  pose proof (per_ctx_env_of_typ (κ := κd) HΓ HA) as HΓA.
  pose proof (rel_exp_under_ctx_shift HΓA HM) as HMwk.
A type that is a Π into κc is of an evaluated kind, by its head, wherever it has a value.
  assert (HΠ : forall Δ R T M0, EF Δ ≈ Δ ∈ per_ctx_env ↘ R -> Δ ⊨ M0 : T ->
                 (forall ρ a, ⟦ T ⟧ ρ ↘ a -> evaluated_kind (domain_kind a)) ->
                 forall ρ ρ', Dom ρ ≈ ρ' ∈ R -> rel_typ_evaluated T ρ).
  { intros * HR HT Hhead ρ0 ρ0' Hρ0.
    destruct (rel_exp_under_ctx_simple_full_at HR HT) as [k Hk0].
    destruct (Hk0 _ _ Hρ0) as (a & _ & _ & Ha & _).
    exists a; split; [ exact Ha | eapply Hhead; exact Ha ]. }
  assert (Hpihead : forall T ρ a, (exists A0 B0, T = a_pi κd κc A0 B0) -> ⟦ T ⟧ ρ ↘ a -> evaluated_kind (domain_kind a))
    by (intros * (? & ? & ->) Ha; inversion Ha; exact Hev0).
  pose proof (HΠ _ _ _ _ HΓ HM (fun ρ a => Hpihead _ ρ a (ex_intro _ _ (ex_intro _ _ eq_refl)))) as HΠrel.
  assert (HΠwkrel : forall ρ ρ' R, EF Γ ▹{κd} A ≈ Γ ▹{κd} A ∈ per_ctx_env ↘ R -> Dom ρ ≈ ρ' ∈ R ->
                      rel_typ_evaluated (a_pi κd κc A B)[↑]ʷ ρ)
    by (intros * HR Hρ0; exact (HΠ _ _ _ _ HR HMwk (fun ρ a => Hpihead _ ρ a (ex_intro _ _ (ex_intro _ _ eq_refl))) _ _ Hρ0)).
  pose proof HM as [? ? k HMgen].
  eexists_rel_exp_with i.
  intros Γ' env_rel' HΓ' σ σ' Hσj ρ ρ' ρσ ρ'σ' Hρ Hev Hev'.
  destruct (rel_typ_of_pi_evaluated HA HA HAk HBt HBr Hk Hev0 _ _ HΓ' _ _ _ _ _ _ Hσj Hρ Hev Hev')
    as [in_rel [a1 [a2 [a3 [a4 [Ha1 [Ha2 [Ha3 [Ha4 [Houter [Hmid Htyp]]]]]]]]]]].
  exists (per_pi a2 a3 in_rel B ρσ B ρ'σ').
  split; [ exact Htyp |]; right.
pairwise needs per_pi to be a PER: it is the element PER of the middle link of the type chain just obtained.
  destruct Htyp as [d1 d2 d3 d4 Hd1 Hd2 Hd3 Hd4 Hdchain].
  assert (Hanchor : DF d2 ≈ d3 ∈ per_univ_elem i ↘ (per_pi a2 a3 in_rel B ρσ B ρ'σ'))
    by pairwise.
  assert (Hρσ : Dom ρσ ≈ ρ'σ' ∈ env_relΓ)
    by (eapply (rel_sub_under_ctx_at' Hσj HΓ' HΓ); eassumption).
M's own chain, brought to the canonical per_pi.
  destruct (HMgen _ _ HΓ' _ _ Hσj _ _ _ _ Hρ Hev Hev') as [RM [HMtyp HMexp]].
  apply (rel_exp_or_prop_evaluated HMtyp (HΠrel _ _ Hρσ)) in HMexp.
  destruct HMtyp as [c1 c2 c3 c4 Hc1 Hc2 Hc3 Hc4 Hcchain].
  destruct HMexp as [m1 m2 m3 m4 Hm1 Hm2 Hm3 Hm4 Hmchain].
  assert (c2 = d_pi κd κc a2 ρσ B) as ->
    by (eapply functional_eval_exp; [ exact Hc2 | apply eval_exp_pi; exact Ha2 ]).
  assert (c3 = d_pi κd κc a3 ρ'σ' B) as ->
    by (eapply functional_eval_exp; [ exact Hc3 | apply eval_exp_pi; exact Ha3 ]).
  assert (HRMmid : DF d_pi κd κc a2 ρσ B ≈ d_pi κd κc a3 ρ'σ' B ∈ per_univ_elem k ↘ RM) by pairwise.
  rewrite (per_pi_iff Hev0 Hmid HRMmid) in Hmchain.
  pose proof (per_univ_elem_kind _ _ _ _ Hmid) as Er23.
The application in the closure's body: to the argument itself at a domain of an evaluated kind, to the variable's kept proof at a proposition.
  assert (Happ : forall T w c' t r ρ0 a0, ⟦ T ⟧ ρ0 ↦ c' ⦂ t ↘ w ->
                   arg_kind gc_deps gc_stack w = domain_kind a0 ->
                   (evaluated_kind (domain_kind a0) -> $| w & c' |↘ r) ->
                   (domain_kind a0 = ak_propositional -> $| w & ⋆ᵈ⟨#0, ρ0 ↦ c' ⦂ t⟩ |↘ r) ->
                   ⟦ T $ #0 ⟧ ρ0 ↦ c' ⦂ t ↘ r).
  { intros * Hw Ew Hrel Hprop.
    destruct (evaluated_kind_or_propositional (domain_kind a0)) as [Ea0 | Ea0].
    - eapply eval_exp_app; [ exact Hw | rewrite Ew; exact Ea0 | apply eval_exp_var_eq; reflexivity | exact (Hrel Ea0) ].
    - eapply eval_exp_app_proof; [ exact Hw | rewrite Ew; exact Ea0 | exact (Hprop Ea0) ]. }
  
The four domains are of one sort, and form a chain at the domain PER.
  pose proof (rel_type_inversion HA) as [env_relΓ0 [HΓ0 HAgen]].
  destruct (HAgen _ _ HΓ' _ _ Hσj _ _ _ _ Hρ Hev Hev') as [e1 e2 e3 e4 He1 He2 He3 He4 Hechain].
  assert (e1 = a1) as -> by (eapply functional_eval_exp; eassumption).
  assert (e2 = a2) as -> by (eapply functional_eval_exp; eassumption).
  assert (e3 = a3) as -> by (eapply functional_eval_exp; eassumption).
  assert (e4 = a4) as -> by (eapply functional_eval_exp; eassumption).
  assert (Hachain : rel_chain (per_univ_elem i in_rel) ([a1; a2; a3; a4]))
    by (eapply per_univ_chain_at_in; [ exact Hechain | | | exact Hmid ]; solve_in).
  assert (HR1 : DF a1 ≈ a2 ∈ per_univ_elem i ↘ in_rel) by pairwise.
  assert (HR3 : DF a3 ≈ a4 ∈ per_univ_elem i ↘ in_rel) by pairwise.

β for a function or for a proof of a ∀ (wf_exp_eq_pi_beta).
Lemma sem_exp_eq_pi_beta :
  `( Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊨ A : Srt ->
     sort_kind Srt κd ->
     Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ▹{κd} A ⊨ B : abs_kind_sort κc Typeω@i ->
     pi_kinds κd κc ->
     Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ▹{κd} A ⊨ M : B ->
     Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊨ N : A ->
     exp_scoped (List.length Γ) N ->
     Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊨ (λ A M) $ N ≈ M[Id,,N] : B[Id,,N] ).
Proof.
  intros * HA HS HB Hk HM HN HNs; sem_intro; [ assumption |].
  destruct Hk as [κd | κd |]; cbn [abs_kind_sort] in *.
  - destruct HS.
    + exact (rel_exp_under_ctx_pi_beta (rel_type_of_typ HA) (rel_type_kind_of_typ HA) evaluated_kind_relevant
               (rel_type_of_typ HB) (rel_type_evaluated_of_typ HB) HM HN HNs).
    + exact (rel_exp_under_ctx_pi_beta_prop HA HB HM HN HNs).
    + exact (rel_exp_under_ctx_pi_beta (rel_type_of_level_sort 0 HA) (rel_type_kind_of_level_sort HA) evaluated_kind_level
               (rel_type_of_typ HB) (rel_type_evaluated_of_typ HB) HM HN HNs).
  - apply rel_exp_under_ctx_proof.
    match goal with HΓ : ⊨ Γ |- _ =>
      exact (rel_exp_under_ctx_instance HΓ HS HA HB HN HNs) end.
  - inversion HS; subst.
    exact (rel_exp_under_ctx_pi_beta (rel_type_of_level_sort 0 HA) (rel_type_kind_of_level_sort HA) evaluated_kind_level
             (rel_type_of_level_sort 0 HB) (rel_type_evaluated_of_level_sort HB) HM HN HNs).
Qed.

η for a function or for a proof of a ∀ (wf_exp_eq_fn_eta).
Lemma sem_exp_eq_fn_eta :
  `( Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊨ A : Srt ->
     sort_kind Srt κd ->
     Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ▹{κd} A ⊨ B : abs_kind_sort κc Typeω@i ->
     pi_kinds κd κc ->
     Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊨ M : a_pi κd κc A B ->
     Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊨ M ≈ λ A M[↑]ʷ $ #0 : a_pi κd κc A B ).
Proof.
  intros * HA HS HB Hk HM; sem_intro; [ assumption |].
  pose proof (sort_kind_type_sort _ _ HS) as HSt.
  pose proof (rel_type_kind_of_sort_kind HS HA) as HAk.
  destruct Hk as [κd | κd |]; cbn [abs_kind_sort] in *.
  - destruct (rel_pi_parts HSt HA HA HB) as [k [Hl [_ Hk]]].
    exact (rel_exp_under_ctx_fn_eta Hl HAk (rel_type_of_typ Hk) (rel_type_kind_of_typ Hk) (pi_kinds_relevant _)
             evaluated_kind_relevant HM).
  - exact (rel_exp_under_ctx_proof (rel_all_of_parts HSt HA HA HB)).
  - inversion HS; subst.
    exact (rel_exp_under_ctx_fn_eta (rel_type_of_level_sort 0 HA) HAk (rel_type_of_level_sort 0 HB)
             (rel_type_kind_of_level_sort HB) pi_kinds_level evaluated_kind_level HM).
Qed.
